executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: The general requirements for the formation of a contract are the following:
options: Assent, capacity to contract, licit cause, two parties, money
Object matter of the contract, incapacity to contract, assent, cause, parties
Object matter of the contract, capacity to contract, mutual assent, cause, parties and money
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The law lists four general requirements: mutual assent, capacity to contract, object matter of the contract, and licit cause. Only the third option contains all four.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: What do you understand by a synallagmatic contract?
options: A contract whereby the beneficiary doesn't have any obligation
A contract whereby the beneficiary has obligations
A contract whereby the beneficiary is bound by the contract
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: A synallagmatic (bilateral) contract is one in which the parties have reciprocal obligations; it is the opposite of a unilateral contract, where the beneficiary has no obligation.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Which is a fundamental principle of public procurement?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Transparency is the first of the eight fundamental principles; single source is a non-competitive exception, and "open competitive" is not worded as a principle (the principle is competition).

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: There are ...... villages in Rwanda.
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Rwanda has 14,837 villages (30 districts, 416 sectors, 2,148 cells).

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: The district executive committee comprises:
options: The district mayor, the vice mayor in charge of economic development, the vice mayor in charge of social affairs
The district mayor, the vice mayor in charge of economic development, the vice mayor in charge of social affairs, the executive secretary
The district mayor, the vice mayor in charge of economic development, the vice mayor in charge of social affairs, the executive secretary of the district council
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The District Executive Committee has three members, including at least one woman: the Mayor, the Vice Mayor for Economic Development and the Vice Mayor for Social Affairs. The Executive Secretary heads the Executive Secretariat, not the Committee.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: According to the official website of the City of Kigali, how many villages does the City of Kigali have?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The City of Kigali's official website states that the City is made up of 1,155 villages (35 sectors, 161 cells).

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Which of the following lists the major characteristics of good governance?
options: Participation, rule of law, responsiveness, accountability, transparency, equity and inclusiveness, efficiency and effectiveness, consensus orientation
Secrecy, arbitrary rule, unresponsiveness and exclusion
Centralised control, discretion without rules and absence of accountability
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: UNESCAP's eight characteristics of good governance are participation, rule of law, transparency, responsiveness, consensus orientation, equity and inclusiveness, effectiveness and efficiency, and accountability; options A to C together list all eight.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: The meeting of the Bureau of the Cell Council is held once ...... and whenever necessary.
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The Bureau of the Cell Council meets once a month and whenever necessary.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: The Village is administered by the Executive Committee comprising of ....
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Article 46 lists five members: Head of Village and the persons in charge of security, social and civil affairs, information and training, and development.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Which of the following is the false source of national sovereignty?
options: National sovereignty belongs to the people of Rwanda who themselves exercise it through referendum, ordinary elections or their representatives.
All power emanates from the people of Rwanda and is exercised in accordance with this Constitution
Government of the people of Rwanda, by the people of Rwanda and for the people of Rwanda
No individual or group of people may arrogate to themselves the exercise of power
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Article 1 of the Constitution (source of national sovereignty) covers the other three statements; "Government of Rwandans, by Rwandans and for Rwandans" is the founding principle of the Republic in Article 4, not a source of sovereignty.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Fill in the missing: Disputes arising from boundaries of Sectors, Cells and Villages are settled by .................... and implemented after the approval of the Provincial Governor.
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The law governing the District says disputes over the boundaries of Sectors, Cells and Villages are settled by the District Council and implemented after approval by the Provincial Governor.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: How many times do the community works supervising committees meet at national level?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: National community works committees meet twice a year and whenever necessary.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Concerning the limits to the competence of the Executive Secretary of the Cell as a non-professional bailiff, in reference to Law No 12/2013 of 22/03/2013 governing the bailiff function in Rwanda, s/he shall only be allowed to:
options: Execute judgements and judicial decisions taken by primary, intermediate and Gacaca Courts and Mediation Committees
Execute decisions taken by Gacaca Courts and decisions from Mediation Committees
Execute only judgements of the Commercial Court and the Supreme Court
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Article 53 of Law 12/2013 limits the Executive Secretary of the Cell to executing decisions of Gacaca Courts and Mediation Committees; the Sector and District Executive Secretaries have the wider list.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Under Law N° 71/2024 governing persons and family, the minimum age of a guardian is (with an exception for a person of majority authorised to marry before 21):
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Art 120(1) of Law 71/2024 now lists six requirements for a guardian (Rwandan national; at least 21 years of age; useful to the child; moral integrity; no prison sentence for genocide, genocide ideology, human trafficking, child defilement or domestic violence offences; not deprived of parental authority). The old Law 32/2016 count (two) no longer applies.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: A minor having attained the age of sixteen (16) years can apply alone for his/her emancipation if:
options: he/she has neither parents nor a guardian
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Art 105(3) of Law 71/2024: a child who has attained 16 years may apply alone for emancipation if he or she has neither parents nor a guardian.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Under Article 105 of Law No 71/2024 governing persons and family, how many categories of persons may apply for the emancipation of a child aged 16 (not counting the child who has neither parents nor guardian and applies alone)?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Art 105(2) of Law 71/2024 lists four applicants: (a) both parents or the surviving parent, (b) the adoptive parent, (c) the guardian with approval of the guardianship council, (d) child's rights organisations. Art 105(3) of the new law additionally lets a child of 16 apply alone if he or she has neither parents nor a guardian, which could make "five" defensible for the unqualified original stem; the reworded stem excludes that case so the answer is four.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: What are the National Symbols of the Republic of Rwanda?
options: National flag, Seal of the Republic, National Anthem
National flag, Motto of the Republic, National Anthem
National flag, Motto of the Republic, Seal of the Republic, National Anthem
National flag, Motto of the Republic, Seal of the Republic
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Article 9 of the Constitution lists four national symbols: the flag, the Motto, the Seal of the Republic and the National Anthem.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: The State of Rwanda, through its Constitution, commits itself to upholding the fundamental principles and ensuring their respect. How many are they?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Article 10 of the Constitution as amended in 2015 lists six fundamental principles (earlier version had eight).

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: When was the ICTR established?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The UN Security Council established the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda by resolution 955 on 8 November 1994.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Which one of the following is not a guiding principle of decentralization?
options: National unity, indivisibility and equitable development
Establish Community data center at cell level
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The guiding principles include subsidiarity, national unity, indivisibility and equitable development, and demarcation of roles and responsibilities. Establishing a community data centre at Cell level is a policy action under data and information systems, not a principle.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Official public holidays are determined by
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Art 53 of Law 66/2018 regulating labour states that a Presidential Order determines the official public holidays; Law 017/2020 on public servants says the same.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Define "Condominium":
options: Land on which a building is erected
All operations aimed at improving the living conditions of urban populations
An operation for reconstruction of an urban area through substitution of old elements
A type of joint ownership of real estate where portions are commonly owned and others individually owned
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Law 15/2010 defines a condominium as a type of joint ownership of real estate in which portions of the property are commonly owned and other portions are individually owned.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: The Abunzi Committee at Cell level is made up of how many people and has a mandate for how long?
options: At the Cell level, the Abunzi Committee is comprised of ten (10) persons and the mandate is for 3 years
At the Cell level, the Abunzi Committee is comprised of three (3) persons and the mandate is for 5 years
At the Cell level, the Abunzi Committee is comprised of seven (7) persons and the mandate is for 5 years renewable
At the Cell level, the Abunzi Committee is comprised of fifteen (15) persons and the mandate is for 10 years non-renewable
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The Abunzi law provides that at Cell and Sector levels the Abunzi Committee has seven persons elected for a renewable term of five years.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: The quorum for the meeting of the Cell Council is ............
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The Presidential Order says the quorum for a Cell Council meeting is two thirds of its members.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Rwanda recently held elections of senators. How many senators are elected, how many are appointed by the President of the Republic and how many are designated by the National Consultative Forum of Political Organisations?
options: 15 senators are elected, 6 are appointed by the President of the Republic and 4 are designated by the Forum of political parties
14 senators are elected, 8 are appointed by the President of the Republic and 4 are designated by the Forum of political parties
20 senators are elected, 8 are appointed by the President of the Republic and 2 are designated by the Forum of political parties
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Article 80 of the Constitution gives a Senate of 26: 12 elected by specific electoral colleges, 8 appointed by the President, 4 designated by the National Consultative Forum of Political Organisations, 1 academic from public and 1 from private higher-learning institutions (elected). 15/6/4, 14/8/4 and 20/8/2 all differ, so "None is correct" is right.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: State institutions (branches of government) at national level are grouped into categories. How many are there?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Art 61 of the Constitution: the branches of government are the Legislature, the Executive and the Judiciary, i.e. three.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: What is the area of Rwanda?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: NISR gives Rwanda's surface area as 26,338 square kilometres (24,210 km2 land plus 2,120 km2 water and swamps).

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: What are the pillars of the National Strategy for Transformation (NST1) 2017-2024?
options: Good governance and capable State; Human resource development and a knowledge-based economy; Private sector-led development; Infrastructure development; Productive, high-value and market-oriented agriculture; Regional and international integration
Human development; Agriculture for wealth creation; Competitiveness and integration; Urbanisation and agglomeration; Accountable and capable State institutions
Economic Transformation; Social Transformation; Transformational Governance
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: NST1 (2017-2024) is built on three pillars: Economic Transformation, Social Transformation and Transformational Governance.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: What are the three forms of decentralisation?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Rwanda's decentralisation policy names three forms: deconcentration, devolution and delegation.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Which organ has the responsibility to coordinate and follow up the Joint Action Development Forum activities?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The Rwanda Governance Board is the institution in charge of coordinating JADF activities at national level.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: With reference to the Presidential Order No 001/01 of 06/02/2023 relating to the Sector, Cell and Village, what are the management organs of the Cell?
options: Council, Executive Secretariat, Development Consultative Committee
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Article 19 of the 2023 Presidential Order lists the Cell Council, the Executive Secretariat and the Consultative Committee on Development of the Cell as the management organs of the Cell.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: What do you understand by "escheat land"?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Law 27/2021 defines escheat land as land with no heir and defines vacant land as abandoned land (separate terms). So "abandoned land", "a swamp" and "land owned by the State" are not the definition.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: How many times does the Advisory Council to fight against corruption and injustice at national level meet per year?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Presidential Order n 072/01 of 31/10/2023, Art. 4(1): the national Advisory Council meets once every semester and whenever necessary, i.e. twice a year.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: How many types of civil status registers exist?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Article 67(1) of Law 71/2024 lists seven civil status registers: birth, death, marriage, guardianship, recognition of children born out of wedlock, adoption and divorce. The 2025 Ministerial Order on civil status registration also has seven register annexes.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Using the Gasanze cell complaints data (received 50,359; resolved 40,868 in total), what is the overall percentage of resolved complaints compared with the total received?
How many sectors does Rwanda have?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Rwanda has 416 sectors.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Which is the lowest administrative entity in Rwanda?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The village (Umudugudu) is the lowest administrative entity, below the cell and the sector.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Define "land lease"
options: full and indefinite rights over land
a contract granting the right to use State land for a fixed period
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: A State land lease is a contract by which the State grants use of its land for a leased period, not full ownership.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: A District is led by the:
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Under Law 065/2021 the District Executive Committee is headed by the District Mayor, who ensures the daily management of the District.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Under Presidential Order N° 072/01 of 31/10/2023, who chairs the Advisory Council to fight against corruption and injustice at sector level?
options: The Chairperson of the Sector Council
The representative of the Rwanda Investigation Bureau at sector level
The representative of the Abunzi Committee at sector level
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Under the current Order the Advisory Council at Sector level is chaired by the Chairperson of the Sector Council; the Sector Executive Secretary is only its Vice-Chairperson. None of the original options (Police rep, Sector Executive Secretary, Ombudsman rep) is the chair, so the original key "Sector Executive Secretary" is wrong today.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: The founding principle of the Republic of Rwanda is:
options: The Republic of Rwanda, by Rwandans and for Rwandans
Government of Rwandans, by Rwandans and for Rwandans
State of Rwandans, by Rwandans and for Rwandans
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The Constitution states that the founding principle of the Republic is 'Government of Rwandans, by Rwandans and for Rwandans'. The other two wordings are not in the Constitution.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Under the order on professional ethics for public servants, within what time must the proceedings over a second-category disciplinary fault be concluded, counted from the date on which the public servant was requested to provide explanations?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The current order on professional ethics of public servants sets no such deadline for requesting the committee; it sets deadlines for concluding proceedings: 30 days for a first-category fault and 3 months for a second-category fault, counted from the request for explanations.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: The Cell Executive Secretary has to know the Presidential Order relating to the Sector, Cell and Village. This Presidential Order is the following
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The order is Presidential Order No 001/01 of 06/02/2023 relating to the Sector, Cell and Village; there is no 002/01.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: For the execution of the tree planting tender in Kinyonzwe Cell to be done through the execution of tender by community participation, the works must have a value not exceeding a certain amount of money. Which amount?
options: a value not exceeding one hundred million Rwandan francs (100,000,000 FRW)
a value not exceeding sixty million Rwandan francs (60,000,000 FRW)
a value not exceeding eighty million Rwandan francs (80,000,000 FRW)
a value not exceeding forty million Rwandan francs (40,000,000 FRW)
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Community-participation works are capped at FRW 40,000,000, but for radical terracing, anti-erosion ditches or tree planting the cap is FRW 60,000,000.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: There are ...... categories of heroes celebrated on Rwanda Heroes' Day.
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Rwandan national heroes are in three categories: Imanzi, Imena and Ingenzi.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: How many countries belong to the African Union?
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: The African Union has 55 Member States, covering all the countries on the African continent.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: On 1st July every year, Rwanda celebrates:
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: 1 July is Independence Day; Liberation Day is 4 July.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: What does MIDIMAR mean in full words?
options: The Ministry of Disaster Management and Rehabilitation Affairs
The Ministry of Disaster Management and Refugee Affairs
The Ministry of Disaster Management, Refugee and Rehabilitation Affairs
The Ministry of Disaster Management and Resettlement Affairs
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: MIDIMAR is the Ministry of Disaster Management and Refugee Affairs. It was later renamed MINEMA, the Ministry in charge of Emergency Management.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: Fill in the missing: The aspirations of the government of Rwanda to become ....................
options: the Upper Middle Income country by 2035 and High Income country by 2050
the Upper Middle Income country by 2035 and High Income country by 2060
the Upper Middle Income country by 2045 and High Income country by 2065
the Upper Middle Income country by 2025 and High Income country by 2060
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Vision 2050 aims for Rwanda to be an upper-middle income country by 2035 and a high-income country by 2050.

executive-secretary-full-mock-1.stem: The number of Cells and Villages in Rwanda are respectively:
executive-secretary-full-mock-1.explanation: Rwanda has 30 districts, 416 sectors, 2,148 cells and 14,837 villages. The ticked 2,184 swaps two digits.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Which organ has the responsibility to promote principles of good governance, democracy, performance and quality services delivery and advise the Government and other concerned institutions thereof?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: This is part of the mandate of the Rwanda Governance Board (RGB).

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Five factors that determine the leadership style are:
options: Goal congruency, level of decision making, degree of interaction, size of institution and personality of members
Goal congruency, decision making, degree of interaction, capacity building and integrity
Goal congruency, decision making, degree of interaction, capacity building and personality of members
Size of institution, decision making, degree of interaction, capacity building and personality of members
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The situational factors that determine leadership style are organisation size, degree of interaction, personality of members, goal congruency, level of decision making and state of the system. Only the first option uses these factors.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: The lowest level oversight and decision making body is called:
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The Village is the lowest administrative level, and its Village Council is the supreme organ of the Village that deliberates on all Village matters. The Cell and Cell Council sit above it, and Isibo is not an administrative entity.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Which of the following can be a member of the public tender committee of a procuring entity?
options: The procurement officer, who is its permanent member and secretary
The head of the procuring entity
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The head of the procuring entity, the logistics officer and the legal advisory staff are all barred from sitting on the public tender committee, so all three are the exception.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: According to the law determining the organisation and functioning of decentralised administrative entities, decentralised administrative entities with legal personality are:
options: The City of Kigali and the district
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The City of Kigali and the districts (outside Kigali) are decentralised entities with legal personality; sectors, cells and villages are decentralised administrative entities without legal personality.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: What would you do if the Chief Budget Manager (CBM) asks you to award the tender to a bidder of his or her choice?
options: Report the CBM to the police
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: A tender must be awarded on the evaluation, and trying to influence subordinates to take an unfair award decision is an offence under the procurement law, so the request must be refused.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: As an officer in charge of Economy and Human Capital development you will be in charge of Cell economy including land issues. In this regard define 'escheat land'.
options: a form of land tenure based on a contract between a person and the State, where it grants him or her full and indefinite rights over the land
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The Land Law defines escheat land as land with no heir. The tick was the definition of freehold, and 'abandoned land' is vacant land.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: As an officer in charge of Economy and Human Capital development you will be in charge of Cell economy including land matters. In this regard define 'freehold'.
options: contract between a State and a person where it grants him or her the right to use a private State land for investment and social welfare purposes for a fixed term
a form of land tenure based on a contract between a person and the State, where it grants him or her full and indefinite rights over the land
type of land ownership based on a long-term contract between the State and a person granting him or her rights on land
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The Land Law defines freehold as a form of land tenure based on a contract between a person and the State granting full and indefinite rights over the land. The first option is the definition of a land concession.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Under Presidential Order No 021/01 of 24/02/2021, the competent authority may dismiss a public servant, without convening the disciplinary committee, if he or she deserts work for at least:
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Under Presidential Order 021/01 of 24/02/2021 desertion is 7 days or more without written explanations (Art 30(13), Art 34), and the authority dismisses without the committee meeting; none of 10/15/30 days is right.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: The following are qualified as non-professional bailiffs, except:
options: Coordinators of access to justice bureaus
Any other persons authorized by the law
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The law lists the DEPUTY coordinators of access to justice bureaus, not the coordinators; prison directors and other persons authorised by law are listed.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: What are the management organs of the Cell in Rwanda according to Presidential Order No 001/01 of 06/02/2023?
options: Council, Executive Secretariat, Consultative Committee on Development
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Article 19 lists the management organs of the Cell as the Cell Council, the Executive Secretariat and the Consultative Committee on Development of the Cell.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Community Works Supervising Committees of the Cell shall meet ...... and whenever it is deemed necessary.
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Community Works Supervising Committees at levels other than national and City of Kigali meet once a month and whenever deemed necessary.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: The Cell Executive Secretary, with regard to his/her supervisors, must respect ...... things according to the professional ethics for public servants.
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Article 13 of the ethics order says a public servant towards supervisors must show respect and politeness, respect instructions, and give accurate information.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Our Country is divided into ... administrative entities
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Rwanda has five provinces (four provinces plus the City of Kigali), and equally five levels of administration (Province, District, Sector, Cell, Village).

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: An ordinary meeting of the land committee is held:
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: An ordinary meeting of the land committee is held once a month, and an extraordinary meeting may be held when necessary.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: How many times do the community works supervising committees of other administrative entities meet?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Committees of the other administrative entities (district, sector, cell, village) meet once a month and whenever necessary.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: The Executive Secretary of the Cell performs daily duties of the Cell administration and produces reports thereof. What are the key parts of a formal report?
options: Title or cover page - Table of contents - Executive summary - Introduction - Body - Conclusion - Recommendations
Title or cover page - Table of contents - Introduction - Body - Recommendations
Title or cover page - Executive summary - Main content - Conclusion - Recommendations
Title or cover page - Introduction - Body - Appendices only
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: A formal report has a title page, table of contents, executive summary, introduction, body, conclusion and recommendations; the other options each omit required parts.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Under Law N° 71/2024, in case a person dies in a correctional facility (prison), the director of the facility registers the death with the civil registrar of the place where the facility is located within ... hours, upon presentation of a death certificate issued by a recognised medical doctor.
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Art 98 of Law 71/2024: the director of the correctional facility registers the death within 72 hours with the civil registrar of the place where the facility is located, on presentation of a death certificate issued by a recognised medical doctor.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Under Law N° 71/2024, how many components (organs) of guardianship of a child are there?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Art 112 of Law 71/2024: the components of guardianship of a child are two, (a) the guardianship council and (b) the guardian.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Fill the missing: Umuganda became an official government program ...... organized on a regular basis once a week with the ministry of district development in charge of overseeing the program.
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The Rwanda Governance Board timeline says that under the Second Republic Umuganda was officially launched on 2 February 1974 and placed in the ministry responsible for district development.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Under Presidential Order N° 001/01 of 06/02/2023, the number of organs which manage the Cell is:
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The Cell has three management organs: the Cell Council, the Executive Secretariat and the Consultative Committee on Development of the Cell.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: How often is the Consultative Committee on Development of the Cell meeting held?
options: It is held every 3 months and whenever necessary
It is held depending on the availability of its members
It is held every six months and whenever necessary
It is held when the Executive Secretary of the Sector calls members for urgent matters
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The Presidential Order on Sector, Cell and Village says the meeting of the Cell Consultative Committee on Development is held every six months and whenever necessary.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Who are the members of the Village Council among the following?
options: A representative of non-governmental organisations operating in the Village
A representative of teachers of secondary schools located in the Village
Members of the Executive Committee of the National Women Council at the Village level
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The Village Council comprises members of the Executive Committees of the National Women Council and National Youth Council, community health workers, farmer promoters, Umugoroba w'Umuryango committee members and two private sector representatives.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: In 2005 the Umuganda policy was adopted. According to the policy, participation in Umuganda is obligatory for every Rwandan between the ages of 18 and 65, but some categories of people are exempted and may participate if they wish. Which category of people participates of their own wish?
options: Expatriates and those above 65 years old
The National Army and the National Police
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The 2005 Umuganda policy makes Umuganda obligatory for Rwandans aged 18 to 65, while expatriates and people above 65 may take part if they wish.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: If the District Mayor and his or her deputies are dismissed at the same time, within a period of three (3) months from the day they ceased their duties, the ........ convenes an extraordinary meeting of the District Council to elect from among its members an acting Mayor.
options: The President of the District Council
The Minister in charge of local government
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Art 48 of Law 065/2021 governing the District: the Provincial Governor convenes the extraordinary District Council meeting to elect an acting Mayor.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Resolutions of the public tender committee are valid if voted by ... of its members present.
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Art 17 of the 2023 Ministerial Order on public procurement regulations: resolutions of the public tender committee are valid if voted by three-fifths of the members present (consensus if only three-fifths are present). Three-fifths is not two-thirds, three-quarters or one-half.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Which law currently governs civil registration in Rwanda?
options: Law N° 71/2024 of 26/06/2024 governing persons and family
Law N° 32/2016 of 28/08/2016 governing persons and family
Law N° 27/2016 of 08/07/2016 governing matrimonial regimes, donations and successions
Law N° 001/2020 of 02/02/2020 amending Law N° 32/2016
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Civil registration is now governed by Law No 71/2024 of 26/06/2024 governing persons and family, which in Art 404 repeals Law 32/2016 of 28/08/2016 (as modified, i.e. including Law 001/2020) and Law 27/2016. Implementing rules: Ministerial Order 001/07.01 of 21/05/2025 on civil status registration.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: How many grounds are there for establishing the guardianship of a minor?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Article 111 of Law 71/2024 lists four grounds for establishing guardianship of a child: (a) death/disappearance/absence of both parents or unknown parents; (b) denial of paternity or maternity; (c) parents alive but deprived of parental authority; (d) surviving parent with a disability preventing parental responsibility. "None of the mentioned" is replaced by the real value (four) so the item survives shuffling.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Cell responsibilities include:
options: (a) provide basic services; (b) collect numerical data; (c) encourage the population to contribute to sustainable development
(a) implement development programmes; (b) promote good governance and social welfare
(a) gather basic data on welfare; (b) maintain security and resolve conflicts; (c) provide reliable information on Government programmes; (d) take decisions on delegated issues
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Presidential Order 001/01 of 06/02/2023 Art 18 gives the Cell three responsibilities: provide basic services, collect numerical data, and encourage the population to contribute to and participate in sustainable development activities.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Using the Gasanze cell complaints data (received 23,456; 14,578; 8,000 and 4,325 over four fiscal years), what is the average number of complaints received per fiscal year?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Total received 50,359 divided by 4 years = 12,589.75, about 12,589.7.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: In which city is the African Union Headquarters located?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The African Union headquarters is in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: From when has Rwanda been a full member of the Commonwealth?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Rwanda joined the Commonwealth in 2009 as its 54th member.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: The overall NST1 M&E Framework is grounded on key guiding principles. How many are they?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: NST1 lists five guiding principles: comprehensiveness; participation and inclusiveness; leverage of ICT tools and dashboards; consistency and harmonization between sector and district strategies; flexibility.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Which one of the following is not a characteristic of customer service strengths?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Standard customer-service skill lists name empathy, communication, patience and problem-solving as strengths, so impatience is the opposite of a strength.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: When did Rwanda join the EAC?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Rwanda (with Burundi) joined the East African Community in July 2007.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: The Rwandan financial year ends on:
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Rwanda's financial year runs from 1 July to 30 June.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Which of these is a province of Rwanda?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Rwanda has four provinces (Eastern, Western, Northern, Southern) plus the City of Kigali; there is no Central or Lake Province.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Which statement is true among the following? By Vision 2050,
options: Rwanda is on a transformation path from a middle-income to a high-income country
Rwanda is on a transformation path from a low-income to a high-income country
Rwanda is on a transformation path from a low-income to a middle-income country
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Vision 2050 starts from a 2019 GDP per capita of USD 837 (low income) and aims for upper-middle income by 2035 and high income by 2050, so the end-point is high income.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: The most populated district in Rwanda is located in which province?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Gasabo, in the City of Kigali, is the most populated district (879,505 residents in the 2022 census).

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Rwanda joined the African Union on ......
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Rwanda is listed by the African Union as a member since 25 May 1963, the founding date of the OAU that became the AU in 2002.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: How many are the guiding principles adopted for the RBM-based performance management system in the Public Service in Rwanda?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Section 6 of the RBM Policy lists seven principles: accountability, ownership, inclusiveness, alignment of operations to RBM, evidence-based learning, transparency, and a culture of results.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Define "master plan"
options: a document guiding land use and development of an area
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: A land use and development master plan is the document adopted to guide how land and areas are used and developed.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Umuganda is a Home Grown Solution meaning:
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Umuganda means community work ("coming together in common purpose to achieve an outcome"), a Rwandan Home Grown Solution.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: The District Council has different powers according to the law. How many?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Article 11 of the District law lists two powers of the District Council: to suspend a councillor or Executive Committee member, and to set administrative sanctions for those violating its instructions.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Rwandan National Heroes are classified in how many categories?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Rwandan national heroes are classified in three categories: Imanzi, Imena and Ingenzi.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: Staff members of the Executive Secretariat of the Cell are the following:
options: Executive Secretary of Cell and SEDO
The staff members of the District responsible for the implementation of the daily responsibilities of the Cell
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Under the 2023 Presidential Order, Cell Executive Secretariat staff members are employees of the District in charge of implementing the Cell's responsibilities on a daily basis, supervised by the Sector Executive Secretary.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: When did the Imihigo performance contracts start in Rwanda?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Imihigo was reintroduced in 2006; the first contracts were signed between the President and mayors on 4 April 2006.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: The District Coordination Committee meets once ...... and whenever necessary.
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: Law No 065/2021 Art. 59: the District Coordination Committee meets once every year and whenever necessary.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: The National Strategy for Transformation one (NST1) has how many crosscutting areas?
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: NST1 considered seven cross-cutting areas: capacity development, HIV/AIDS and non-communicable diseases, disability and social inclusion, gender and family promotion, regional integration and international positioning, disaster management, and environment and climate change.

executive-secretary-full-mock-2.stem: The Chairperson of the Cell Council submits to the Executive Secretary of the Sector in which the Cell is located, the resolutions of the Cell Council within ... days from the date of the meeting
executive-secretary-full-mock-2.explanation: The Cell Council chairperson sends the resolutions to the Sector Executive Secretariat within five days of the meeting (the Sector then has seven working days to give its views).

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: The responsibilities, powers, organisation and functioning of the District Security Committee are determined by:
options: The decision of the district council
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Law 065/2021 Article 55 says a Presidential Order determines the responsibilities, powers, organisation and functioning of the District Security Committee (the same rule was in Article 86 of the earlier Law 87/2013). A Prime Minister's order, a Minister of MINALOC order and a district council decision are all wrong.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: The Executive Secretary of the Cell shall only be allowed to execute decisions taken by ... organs.
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The Cell Executive Secretary implements programmes approved by the competent higher authorities and those approved by the Cell Council (and decisions of the Consultative Committee reach him through the Council): two sources of decisions.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: When did the 2021 election of the District Executive Committees take place?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The district Executive Committees (mayors and vice mayors) were elected on Friday 19 November 2021, after district councils were elected earlier that week.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Who are the members of the steering committee at sector level?
options: The Sector Executive Secretary, the representative of the Rwanda National Police and the president of the sector council
The Sector Executive Secretary, the representative of the Rwanda National Police and the staff in charge of community works
The Sector Executive Secretary, the representative of the Rwanda National Police, the president and vice president of the sector council
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Prime Minister's Order 58/03 creates two supervising organs (a Steering Committee and a Technical Committee) only at national, provincial and Kigali City levels; other entities, including the Sector, have only a Technical Committee (Executive Secretary, Cell Executive Secretaries, officer in charge of agriculture, women and youth council coordinators, Intore representatives). So no listed membership of a sector "steering committee" is right.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: In Rwandan government institutions, the financial year starts in:
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The fiscal year runs for twelve months from 1 July to 30 June, so it starts in July.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Members of the land committee at Cell level are appointed by ................................
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Members of the land committee at Cell level are appointed by the Sector Council, while Sector-level members are appointed by the Council of the District with legal personality or of the City of Kigali.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: How many councillors were elected per District in the previous Local Government election?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Under Law 065/2021 Article 12 a District Council has 17 councillors: 8 elected at District level, 5 women councillors and 4 coordinators/representatives. None of 21, 18 or 67 equals 8, 13 or 17, so "None is correct" holds. The 2026 elections law only changes HOW the eight seats are filled (electoral college instead of direct vote), not the numbers.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Within five days of the meeting, the Chairperson of the Cell Council submits the resolutions of the Cell Council to:
options: Executive Secretariat of the Sector in which the Cell is located
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The Chairperson of the Cell Council submits the Council's resolutions within five days to the Executive Secretariat of the Sector, with a copy to the District Authority, so the Sector verifies their conformity with the laws.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Which of the following is a legal marriage in Rwanda?
options: A civil monogamous marriage contracted between a man and a woman upon mutual consent
A customary marriage contracted before elders
A religious marriage contracted before a church
A polygamous marriage registered by the civil registrar
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Article 195(1) of Law 71/2024: "Civil monogamous marriage contracted between a man and a woman upon mutual consent is the only recognised marriage", publicly officiated by the civil registrar. (Under Law 32/2016 as amended by Law 001/2020, Art 166 said the same "before the public administration".)

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: What is the Rwanda national motto?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The Constitution states the motto of the Republic is Unity, Work, Patriotism (Ubumwe, Umurimo, Gukunda Igihugu).

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: The NST1 targets eradication of extreme poverty by:
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: NST1 (7 Year Government Programme 2017-2024) states that it targets eradication of extreme poverty by 2024, so 2030, 2034 and 2050 are all wrong.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: By definition Home grown solutions are:
options: innovations that have proved to be the solutions to a particular problem;
Rwanda's 'trade mark' solutions developed by Rwandans based on local opportunities, cultural values and history to fast track their development.
innovations that address a challenge in a new and different way often through simpler and more effective approaches
innovations or initiatives rooted in the Rwandan cultural heritage and values
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The Rwanda Governance Board defines Home Grown Solutions as Rwanda's 'trade mark' solutions developed by Rwandans based on local opportunities, cultural values and history to fast track their development. The other options describe only parts of the criteria.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Which of the following is not among the aspirations and shared values which will define Rwandans in 2050 as reflected in Rwanda Vision 2050?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Vision 2050 lists self-determination (Kwigira), solidarity and dignity, unity and Rwandan identity/culture, and equity/inclusiveness as the shared values; service delivery is not a shared value (openness and accountability are mentioned in the same section).

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: The Cell has ...... key responsibilities.
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Article 18 lists three responsibilities of the Cell: provide basic services, collect numerical data, and encourage the population to contribute to sustainable development activities.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: The Executive Secretary of the Cell submits a report of the Cell activities to the Authority of the Sector ...... and whenever necessary, with a copy to the Cell Council.
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Article 36 says the Cell Executive Secretary reports to the Sector authority once a month and whenever necessary.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: What is the smallest administrative unit in Rwanda?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The District is divided into Sectors, Cells and Villages; the Village (Umudugudu) is the smallest administrative entity.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Ministry of Justice organizes the training of Abunzi through MAJ bureau in all districts once per year. What does MAJ mean in full words?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: MAJ stands for Maison d'Accès à la Justice (Access to Justice Bureau), established in all 30 districts from 2007 under the Ministry of Justice.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Fill in the missing: ............ the Ministry of Local Government, in collaboration with the National Itorero Commission and Local Administrative Entities Development Agency, launched Itorero at village level across the country.
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: MINALOC, with the National Itorero Commission and LODA, launched Itorero at village level on 11 December 2018 (national event in Nyagatare).

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: How many times do the community works supervising committees meet at provincial level?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Community works supervising committees at Provincial and Kigali City levels meet four times a year and whenever necessary.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Gasanze Cell received and resolved citizens' complaints as follows: 2017-2018: received 23,456, resolved 15,541; 2018-2019: received 14,578, resolved 13,312; 2019-2020: received 8,000, resolved 7,790; 2020-2021: received 4,325, resolved 4,225. What is the general percentage of complaints resolved, compared with the total number of complaints received?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Resolved divided by received is 40,868 / 50,359 = 0.8115, i.e. 81.1%.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: How many management organs of a District exist?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Law 065/2021 Article 9 lists four management organs of a District: Council, Executive Committee, Executive Secretariat and Security Committee.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: This member is not among the Cell Council composition:
options: One councillor elected at the level of each Village of the Cell
The female councillors who constitute at least thirty per cent of the members of the Cell Council
A representative of teachers of secondary schools located in the Cell
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The Cell Council includes a representative of teachers of primary schools and of head teachers of nursery schools, not secondary-school teachers. The village councillors and the at-least-30% women are members.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Mobilisation is one of the responsibilities of the Cell. The Government has put in place mechanisms of mobilisation that facilitate the flow of information. Which of the following is NOT among the mechanisms of mobilisation?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Umuganda, Ubudehe and community assemblies (Inteko z'abaturage) are mobilisation and participation platforms; potable water is a service, not a mobilisation mechanism.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Which one of the following is NOT a responsibility of a Village?
options: Monitor how services are delivered to the population
Take decisions on other issues delegated by higher authorities
Ensure that the Village population are enlightened and characterised by exemplary behaviour of synergy and solidarity
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The Village's responsibilities are to gather basic welfare data, maintain security and resolve conflicts, inform the population about Government programmes and take delegated decisions; monitoring service delivery belongs to the Cell Consultative Committee on Development.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Which of the following lists only current EAC Partner States?
options: Tanzania, Uganda, Kenya, Burundi, Rwanda, South Sudan, DRC and Somalia
Tanzania, Uganda, Kenya, Zambia and Rwanda
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The EAC has eight Partner States: Burundi, DRC, Kenya, Rwanda, Somalia, South Sudan, Tanzania and Uganda, so all three listed groups are partner states.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Rwanda's fiscal year runs from:
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Organic Law on Public Finance Management defines the fiscal year as twelve months running from 1 July to 30 June.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: ..... determines modalities for collaboration between a District and State institutions at national level.
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Art 61 of Law 065/2021 governing the District: a Prime Minister's Order determines the modalities for collaboration between a District and State institutions at national level.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: ...... is responsible for putting in place strategies to mobilize the citizens on their participation in interventions meant for them and accountability in respect thereof.
options: Office of the President of the Republic
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: This is item 9 of the Rwanda Governance Board's core mandate, under its establishing law.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: The Community Works Supervising Committee at the Cell level shall have ...... functions.
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Article 9 of Prime Minister's Order No 58/03 of 24/08/2009 gives the Community Works Supervising Committee at the Cell level eight functions (plan/prepare/supervise; evaluate and report; collaborate with the population; coordinate; sensitise; report to the Sector committee; manage equipment; ensure enforcement of the community works law). The "None" option is replaced by the real value (eight) so the item survives shuffling.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: If a child is not declared before the civil registrar due to negligence or other grounds and later dies before the declaration of his or her birth, his or her birth ...
options: Is registered in the record of births
May be registered before the civil registrar
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Article 92(2) of Law 71/2024: a child whose birth was not declared to the civil registrar for any reason and who later dies has his or her birth recorded in the register of births and his or her death in the register of deaths.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: The EAC comprises ... Partner States.
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Somalia became the 8th Partner State on 4 March 2024, joining Burundi, DRC, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Uganda.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: The number of management organs of the Cell is:
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The Cell has three management organs: the Cell Council, the Executive Secretariat and the Consultative Committee on Development of the Cell.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: How many districts does Rwanda have?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Rwanda has 30 districts.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Judicially, the difference between a district and its lower entities (sector, cell, village) is that:
options: In the district highest decisions are taken by the council
A district has financial and HR autonomy, lower entities don't
A district has legal personality; lower entities do not
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Law 065/2021 says a district has legal personality (and autonomy), while sectors, cells and villages are decentralised entities without legal personality.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Which districts make up Kigali City?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The City of Kigali has three districts: Gasabo, Kicukiro and Nyarugenge.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Which of these districts is in the Northern Province?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Northern Province has five districts: Burera, Gakenke, Gicumbi, Musanze and Rulindo. Rubavu is Western, Huye Southern, Rwamagana Eastern.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Which is an organ of the Cell?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The management organs of the Cell are the Cell Council, the Executive Secretariat and the Consultative Committee on Development.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: The Bureau of the Sector Council is composed of:
options: The chairperson, the vice-chairperson and the secretary
The chairperson, the vice-chairperson, the secretary and a rapporteur
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The Bureau of the Sector Council is made up of the Chairperson, the Vice-Chairperson and the Secretary, elected from among the councillors after swearing in.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: How many members does the District Council have?
options: The number of members depends on the number of sectors of each district
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Under the current District law, the District Council comprises seventeen councillors: eight elected at District level, five women, the three coordinators of the youth, women and disability councils, and the private sector chairperson. The number no longer depends on the number of sectors.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: The Cell Executive Secretary is a member of the District Coordination Committee. How many categories of persons form this coordination committee?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Article 58 of Law 065/2021 lists eight categories, including the Executive Secretaries of cells.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Which organ has the responsibility to finance development activities in local administrative entities with legal personality?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The first mission of LODA, the Local Administrative Entities Development Agency, is to finance development activities in local administrative entities with legal personality.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Within how many days must every child be declared?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Under the current persons and family law, a birth outside a health facility is registered within 30 days (births in a health facility are registered immediately).

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Which one of the following is a false criterion for the appointment of members of land committees?
options: have information on land located in the Cell or Sector of operation of the land committee of which he or she is proposed to be a member, relating to land ownership, land successive use and issues thereon
live in a Cell or Sector of operation of the land committee of which he or she is proposed to be a member
be aged at least eighteen (18) years
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: A land committee member must live in the Cell or Sector, have information on land there and have integrity, and must be aged at least twenty-one (21) years, not eighteen.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Which one of the following is not a member of the Cell Council?
options: a representative of non-government organisations operating in the Cell
the Coordinator of the National Council of Persons with Disabilities at the Cell level
a representative of head teachers of nursery schools located in the Cell, if any
a representative of private sector in the Cell
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The Cell Council has a councillor per Village, the Cell coordinators of the Youth, Women and Persons with Disabilities councils, female councillors (30%), a nursery-school heads representative, a primary-school teachers representative and a private-sector representative. NGOs sit on the Consultative Committee on Development, not on the Cell Council.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Imihigo were divided into different categories. How many are these categories?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Imihigo are in two categories, Joint Imihigo and Individual (institutional) Imihigo.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: When did Rwanda join the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie (OIF)?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Rwanda has been a member of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie since 1970 (a founding member of the original agency, ACCT, created in 1970).

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Home Grown Solutions (HGS) are Rwanda's 'trade mark' solutions developed by Rwandans based on ... key points.
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: RGB lists five criteria that an innovation must meet to qualify as a Home Grown Solution.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: Rwanda's ambition to become a developed country hinges on its ability to enhance competitiveness at macro and micro levels. Rwanda is targeting to:
options: Belong to the top 20 countries in doing business in 2035 and maintain the status; rank among the top 20 economies in competitiveness by 2035 and top 10 in 2050
Belong to the top 10 countries in doing business in 2035 and maintain the status; rank among the top 20 economies in competitiveness by 2035 and top 10 in 2050
Belong to the top 5 countries in doing business in 2035 and maintain the status; rank among the top 20 economies in competitiveness by 2035 and top 10 in 2050
Belong to the top 3 countries in doing business in 2035 and maintain the status; rank among the top 20 economies in competitiveness by 2035 and top 10 in 2050
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Under the Competitiveness and Integration pillar, Vision 2050 targets a place among the top 10 countries in doing business in 2035, top 20 economies in competitiveness by 2035 and top 10 in 2050.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: JADF is among other tools used to boost the implementation of Imihigo at Sector level and JADF activities at Sector level are overseen by the Sector Executive Secretary. How many key responsibilities does the Sector Executive Secretary have in JADF?
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: Under the Prime Minister's Instructions on the Joint Action Development Forum, the Sector Executive Secretary is particularly responsible for three things: facilitating stakeholders seeking services at Sector level, monitoring JADF operations at Sector level, and reporting on them.

executive-secretary-full-mock-3.stem: The responsibilities, composition and functioning of the Advisory Council for the Fight against Injustice and Corruption at Sector level are determined by:
options: The Advisory Council at District level
executive-secretary-full-mock-3.explanation: The current Presidential Order 072/01 of 31/10/2023 itself sets the composition and responsibilities of the Advisory Council at sector level (Arts 26-31) and has no cell-level council; none of the options names it.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: One of the reasons for dissolution of the matrimonial regime is:
options: Management of the property of the family
Modification of the type of matrimonial regime
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: A matrimonial regime ends by divorce, change of the type of regime, or death of one of the spouses (not of both).

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Districts are the most autonomous entities of the decentralised system because:
options: They have financial and administrative independence
They have social and economic dependence
They have social, economic and financial independence
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: A District has legal personality and enjoys administrative, financial and human resource management autonomy.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Some of the following items are types of public procurement:
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The types of public procurement are works, goods or supplies, consultancy services and non-consultancy services. Receiving bids and the contract itself are not types.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: What do you understand by "illicit benefits"?
options: Any benefit solicited, offered, accepted or promised illegally in order to render or omit a service
Any benefit solicited, offered, accepted or promised illegally in order to render an act prohibited by the law
Any advantages accepted or promised illegally in order to render or omit a service
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The law defines an illicit benefit as any benefit solicited, offered, accepted or promised illegally in order to render or omit a service.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The budget of the district is approved by:
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Among the responsibilities of the District Council is to adopt the budget of the District.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: What is the supreme cell organ that should take decisions on all matters related to the responsibilities of the cell in accordance with the laws, orders and instructions adopted by the higher organs?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The Cell Council is the highest organ of the Cell and takes decisions on matters relating to the Cell's responsibilities that do not contradict laws or decisions of higher organs.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: As a civil registrar, select the right statement. Registration of the birth of a child whose mother is married, but who denies it, alleging that the father of the child is unknown: the child is registered on:
options: His/her mother's husband, and correction thereof is submitted to the competent authority
His/her grandfather, and correction thereof is submitted to the competent authority
His/her mother only, and correction thereof is submitted to the competent authority
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Under the current Law 71/2024, a child born during marriage is presumed to be the child of the mother's husband (Art 281), so the registrar registers the child on the mother's husband and any contest goes through correction to the competent authority.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Gasanze Cell received and resolved citizens' complaints as follows: 2017-2018: received 23,456, resolved 15,541; 2018-2019: received 14,578, resolved 13,312; 2019-2020: received 8,000, resolved 7,790; 2020-2021: received 4,325, resolved 4,225. How many complaints were not resolved and may be oriented to other institutions?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Unresolved = total received 50,359 minus total resolved 40,868 = 9,491.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: How many are persons qualified as nonprofessional bailiffs?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Article 50 of Law 12/2013 lists seven non-professional bailiffs (district, sector and cell executive secretaries, deputy coordinators of MAJ, ministry civil servant, prison director, others authorised by law).

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The Cell Executive Secretary is a public servant at cell level and he/she is supposed to know the law governing the district. Which one?
options: Law N° 064/2021 of 09/10/2021 governing the District
Law N° 065/2022 of 09/10/2022 governing the District
Law N° 065/2021 of 09/10/2021 governing the District
Law N° 063/2021 of 09/10/2021 governing the District
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The District is governed by Law No 065/2021 of 09/10/2021.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Who are the members of the community works Technical Committee at cell level?
options: Members of the Advisory Committee of the Cell
The Coordinator of the National Youth Council only
The Executive Committee of the Village only
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: At cell level the Technical Committee is made up of the members of the Cell Advisory (Consultative) Committee.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The following is the law governing the District which you are supposed to know:
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The law governing the District is Law N° 065/2021 of 09/10/2021.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: What are outcome indicators of Enhanced citizen participation, empowerment and inclusiveness?
options: % of citizen satisfaction with the performance of local government councils
% of citizens satisfaction in their participation in planning disaggregated by gender and age
Proportion of seats held by women in Local governments at district, sector and cell level
To ensure that service delivery to the citizens meet the highest quality standards
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Under Outcome 1 "Enhanced citizen participation, empowerment and inclusiveness", the outcome indicators are citizen satisfaction in participation in planning, budgeting and decision making, and gender parity in leadership. Satisfaction with councils and seats held by women are output 1.1 indicators.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Among the following, which is an outcome indicator selected to improve service delivery across all sectors?
options: Inculcate quality service delivery culture among service providers and service recipients
Regulatory framework and standards for service delivery
The % of overall net citizens' satisfaction with service delivery
Proportion of the population satisfied with the last experience of public service
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The Governance and Decentralisation Sector Strategic Plan names two outcome indicators for improved service delivery: the level of quality service delivery and the % of overall net citizens' satisfaction with service delivery. The others are interventions or output-level indicators.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Gasanze Cell received and resolved citizens' complaints as follows: 2017-2018: received 23,456, resolved 15,541; 2018-2019: received 14,578, resolved 13,312; 2019-2020: received 8,000, resolved 7,790; 2020-2021: received 4,325, resolved 4,225. What is the general average of complaints received per fiscal year in Gasanze?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Average received = 50,359 / 4 = 12,589.75, which matches 12589.7 (truncated).

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Define "escheat land":
options: Land tenure based on a contract between a person and the State granting full and indefinite rights
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Law 27/2021 governing land defines escheat land as land with no heir (abandoned land is "vacant land").

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: What benefits do the members of the Cell Council receive?
options: The members of the Cell Council perform their responsibilities on a voluntary basis for the development of the community with regard to good governance and social welfare
The members of the Cell Council receive a monthly salary equivalent to the salary received by the Executive Secretary of the Cell
During meetings, the members of the Cell Council receive a special bonus calculated on the basis of the villages within their jurisdiction
Members of the Cell Council do not have a fixed salary but receive a bonus which depends on the means of the Cell
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Under the Presidential Order on the Sector, Cell and Village, Cell Council members serve on a voluntary basis for community development in good governance and social welfare; they receive no salary.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Which of the following is not a tip for building an effective brand awareness campaign?
options: Spreading your energy across multiple social media platforms
Focus on the platforms your audience uses most
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Brand awareness guidance advises understanding your target audience, partnering with brands that share your audience and focusing on the channels your audience uses most. Spreading effort thinly across many platforms is the opposite of that advice.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: What is NST1 in full?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: NST1 is the National Strategy for Transformation (2017-2024), the 7 Years Government Programme. The other expansions are invented.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The Rwanda Governance Scorecard (RGS) 9th edition is built on how many pillars, indicators and variables?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: RGB states that the eight pillars and 35 indicators were kept in the 10th edition while variables rose from 144 (9th edition) to 151.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: What are the management organs of the District?
options: The Sector Council; the Executive Secretariat; the Security Committee
The District Administrative Unit; the Executive Secretariat; the Security Committee
The Council in charge of budget; the Executive Secretariat; the Consultative Committee on Development
District Council, Executive Committee, District Executive Secretariat, District Security Committee
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Law 065/2021 lists four management organs of a District: the District Council, the District Executive Committee, the Executive Secretariat of the District and the District Security Committee.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The decisions of the meeting of the Consultative Committee on Development of the Cell are taken by consensus. How are decisions taken in the absence of consensus between members?
options: In the absence of consensus, the Chairperson of the Committee calls upon the Executive Secretary to guide the meeting
In the absence of consensus, the meeting is postponed and reconvened within a period of 15 days
In the absence of consensus, the Mayor of the District is convened and he alone takes the decision
In the absence of consensus, decisions are taken by absolute majority of votes of the members of the Committee present. In case of a tie, the Chairperson of the meeting has a casting vote
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Without consensus, decisions are taken by absolute majority of votes of members present; in a tie the Chairperson of the meeting has the casting vote.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The decisions of the guardianship Council are taken by ..... majority of its members present.
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Art 117 of Law 71/2024: decisions of the guardianship council are taken by a two-third majority of its members present (same rule was Art 126 of repealed Law 32/2016).

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Who is the chairperson of the Advisory Council to fight against corruption and injustice at national level?
options: The representative of Rwanda National Police at national level
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Art 2 of Presidential Order 072/01 of 31/10/2023: the Minister in charge of justice is Chairperson, the Minister in charge of local government is Vice-Chairperson and the Ombudsman is Rapporteur.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Corruption is reflected in different acts. How many?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Art 2(2) of Law 54/2018: corruption is reflected in twelve acts (a to l). Twelve is not 8, 9 or 10.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: To be a member of the district executive committee a person must meet the conditions required by:
options: The instructions of the Prime Minister
The instructions from the electoral commission
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Art 38 of Law 065/2021 governing the District: to be a member of the District Executive Committee a person must meet the conditions required by the Organic Law governing elections. That is none of MINALOC instructions, Prime Minister instructions or electoral commission instructions.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Limits of competence of the Executive Secretary of the Cell as a non-professional bailiff (Law 12/2013): he or she shall be allowed to execute only:
options: Judgements and decisions of primary, intermediate and Gacaca Courts and Mediation Committees
Decisions taken by Gacaca Courts and decisions from Mediation Committees
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Article 53 of Law 12/2013 limits the Cell Executive Secretary to executing decisions of Gacaca Courts and Mediation Committees; District and Sector Executive Secretaries may also execute primary and intermediate court judgements.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: How many provinces does Rwanda have (excluding the City of Kigali)?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Rwanda has 4 provinces plus the City of Kigali.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Which option lists the pillars of Vision 2050?
options: Human Development; Competitiveness and Integration; Agriculture for Wealth Creation; Urbanization and Agglomeration; Accountable and Capable State Institutions
Development of human resource, financial development, industry development
Good governance, economic development, social development
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Rwanda Vision 2050 is built on five pillars: Human Development, Competitiveness and Integration, Agriculture for Wealth Creation, Urbanization and Agglomeration, and Accountable and Capable State Institutions.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: MINECOFIN asks districts to consult sector and cell levels on new projects. The role of this consultation is to align:
options: National plan and budget with citizens' needs
District plan and budget with citizens' needs
Sector plan and budget with citizens' needs
Donor project plans with citizens' needs
