executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Consultation of the sector and cell levels lets the district align its own plan and budget with citizens' priorities.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Which ministry is in charge of local government?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: MINALOC, the Ministry of Local Government, is in charge of local government and territorial administration.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Rwanda's Decentralization Policy was inspired by ...... fundamental principles which had been violated until 1994.
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The policy was inspired by four fundamental principles: human rights, dignity, freedom and development.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Which of these districts is in the Southern Province?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Huye is one of the eight districts of Southern Province; Musanze is Northern, Rubavu Western and Kayonza Eastern.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The Cell Council is the:
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The Cell Council is the highest organ of the Cell and takes decisions on the Cell's responsibilities.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Decentralization is a sensitive governance reform process that is often politically unpopular. It can only succeed with ...... from top leadership.
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The National Decentralization Policy (October 2021) states decentralization can only succeed with immense political will from top leadership.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Which of the following is a responsibility of the Head of the Village?
options: To convene and chair the meetings of the Village Executive Committee
To advise the Cell on economic development issues
To identify priority activities for poverty reduction and service delivery
To monitor how services are delivered to the population
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Under the 2023 order the Head of the Village leads the Village, coordinates and chairs the Executive Committee, follows up Village Council decisions, disseminates Government policies, handles civil and cultural issues and reports to the Cell. None of the four options is among them.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Fill the missing: Performance contracts (Imihigo) program has been launched in ......
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Imihigo performance contracts were launched in 2006 (first signed by district mayors with the President).

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Members elected to the Cell Council take in public, within three days following their election, an oath of public officials as provided for by the Constitution of the Republic of Rwanda. The swearing-in ceremony is presided over by:
options: the Authority of the Cell or any other person authorised in writing by the Authority of the District
the Authority of the Sector or any other person authorised in writing by the Authority of the District
the Authority of the District or any other person authorised in writing by the Ministry of Local Government
the court judge or any other person authorised in writing by the Ministry of Justice
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The swearing-in of Cell Council members is presided over by the Authority of the Sector or any person authorised in writing by the Authority of the District.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The Village Council may relieve members of the Village Executive Committee from their duties for ... reasons.
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Article 40(2) lists three grounds: not discharging responsibilities properly, being co-author of a fault, and being the cause of non-performance in the Village.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: What are the last three countries to join the Commonwealth?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Rwanda joined in 2009, then Gabon and Togo in June 2022; no later member is listed.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: On which date every year is the International Anti-Corruption Day celebrated?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The UN General Assembly designated 9 December as International Anti-Corruption Day.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Fill the missing: Umuganda policy was adopted and according to the policy, participation in Umuganda is obligatory to every Rwandan between ................................
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Umuganda is obligatory for Rwandans aged 18 to 65; those above 65 may take part voluntarily.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The relevant Council appoints members of the land committee not later than the:
options: 30th of June of the last year of the term of the land committee in office
1st of June of the last year of the term of the land committee in office
21st of June of the last year of the term of the land committee in office
15th of June of the last year of the term of the land committee in office
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The relevant Council must appoint the land committee members not later than 1 June of the last year of the term of the committee in office; the new committee starts work on 1 July of that year.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The Village has the following responsibilities, except:
options: to take decisions on other issues delegated to it by hierarchically superior organs
to encourage the population to participate in and contribute to sustainable development activities
to gather basic data on the general welfare of the population and to submit it to the organs in charge of its preservation
to maintain security and resolve conflicts
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The Village's responsibilities are to gather basic data, maintain security and resolve conflicts, provide reliable information on Government programmes and collect data on them, and take decisions on issues delegated by higher organs. Encouraging the population to take part in sustainable development is a Cell responsibility.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The planning system shall follow a framework that consists of ... levels
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The Results Based Performance Management policy says the planning system follows a framework of 3 levels: long term, medium term and annual planning.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: How many are the Management organs of the Village?
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Article 38 of the 2023 Presidential Order names two management organs of the Village: the Village Council and the Executive Committee.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: One of the duties of an officer in charge of Cell economy and human capital development is to monitor the implementation of the city master plan through observation of zoning and eradication of illegal construction. In this regard define 'Condominium'.
options: land on which a building is erected
all operations aimed at improving the living conditions of urban populations
an operation which is part of a plan for the reconstruction of an urban area through the substitution of old elements for new elements
a type of joint ownership of real estate in which portions of the property are commonly owned and other portions are individually owned
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The Condominium Law defines a condominium as a type of joint ownership of real estate in which some portions are commonly owned and others individually owned. The tick describes urban renewal.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The Decentralization journey in Rwanda was adopted in 2000. Over two decades later, progress has been realized in various areas including law reforms, whereas Sector, Cell and Village are guided by Presidential Order N° 001/01 of 06/02/2023. As an Economy and Human Capital Officer at Cell level, what are the Cell responsibilities?
options: (a) to provide the basic services; (b) to collect numerical data; (c) to encourage the population to contribute to and participate in sustainable development activities
(a) to implement development programmes; (b) to promote good governance and social welfare

(a) to gather basic data on the general welfare of the population and to submit it to the organs in charge of its preservation; (b) to maintain security and resolve conflicts; (c) to provide the population with reliable information about Government programmes, to encourage the population to implement the programmes and collect data about such programmes; (d) to take decisions on other issues delegated to it by hierarchically superior organs
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: Article 18 of the 2023 Presidential Order gives the Cell three responsibilities: to provide basic services, to collect numerical data, and to encourage the population to contribute to and participate in sustainable development activities.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: The NST1 targets are ambitious but achievable. Realising these targets requires some conditions:
options: Strengthening partnership among key stakeholders and enhancing accountability at all levels
Strengthening collaboration and partnership among all stakeholders and enhancing ownership at all levels
Building strong partnership and collaboration among key stakeholders and accountability at all levels
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The Prime Minister's foreword says the targets are ambitious but achievable and realizing them requires strengthening collaboration and partnership among all stakeholders and enhancing ownership at all levels.

executive-secretary-full-mock-4.stem: Civil Society Organizations and media have key roles in decentralization dynamism in Rwanda. Which one of the following is part of them?
options: Approving indicators to monitor decentralization implementation
Advising on harmonization of legislation on decentralization and harmonize sector policies to reflect devolution
Participation in policy and program development
Facilitating cross sectorial implementation of the decentralization policy and accelerating the envisaged process
executive-secretary-full-mock-4.explanation: The policy gives civil society organisations and media three roles: sensitising citizens and helping them hold service providers to account, participating in policy and programme development, and advocacy. The other three options are tasks of the Ministry in charge of Local Governance and Decentralization.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The community works supervising committee at the cell level shall consist of:
options: The cell ES, the SEDO and the president of the cell council
The cell ES, the SEDO and the vice president of the cell council
The members of the advisory committee
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: At cell level the community works supervising committee consists of the members of the Advisory (Consultative) Committee of the Cell.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: One of the reasons for withdrawing competences from a non-professional bailiff is:
options: Lawful auction of the seized property
Unlawful auction of the unseized property
Lawful auction of the unseized property
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Law 12/2013 Article 55(1) lists "unlawful auction of the seized property" as a reason for withdrawing competences from a non-professional bailiff. Options A (lawful auction of seized property), B (unlawful auction of unseized property) and C (lawful auction of unseized property) each differ from it, so "None of the mentioned" is right.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: A public servant is prohibited from soliciting or accepting gifts, except for:
options: Respect of the culture of his/her country
Receiving payment in return for a favour
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The only permitted purposes are safeguarding the good image of the country, respect of foreign culture, and recognition of performance or innovation.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: How many villages do we have in Rwanda?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: NISR gives Rwanda's administrative structure as 30 districts, 416 sectors, 2,148 cells and 14,837 villages.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The salary of the SEDO is budgeted by:
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Staff of the Cell Executive Secretariat are employees of the District, whose staff salaries are set under the law governing the District, so the district budgets the SEDO salary.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The following persons are not eligible for membership of land committees:
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Persons not eligible for land committees are employees of decentralised entities, public servants in charge of land administration, individuals providing land services, security officers and other employees whose duties are linked to land services. Teachers and veterinary officers are not excluded.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Which Presidential Order determines the responsibilities, organisation and functioning of the Advisory Council for the Fight against Injustice and Corruption?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: N° 54/2018 of 13/08/2018 is the Law on fighting against corruption, not a Presidential Order. The Advisory Council is governed by Presidential Order N° 072/01 of 31/10/2023.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Which law currently governs the declaration of births and deaths in Rwanda?
options: Law No 71/2024 of 26/06/2024 governing persons and family
Law No 32/2016 of 28/08/2016 governing persons and family
Law No 27/2016 of 08/07/2016 governing matrimonial regimes, donations and successions
Law No 59/2008 of 10/09/2008 on prevention and punishment of gender-based violence
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Declaration of births and deaths was governed by Law 32/2016, but Law 71/2024 of 26/06/2024 governing persons and family (Art 404 repeals Law 32/2016 and Law 27/2016) now governs it: births Art 89-92, deaths Art 94-98.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The day-to-day business of a District in the City of Kigali is run by:
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Under Law 22/2019 a District of the City of Kigali has no Council or Executive Committee; its organs are the Executive Organ (District Executive Administrator and Deputy), the Corporate Services Organ and the Security Committee. The District Executive Administrator manages the daily activities of the District, so none of the listed bodies is right.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Gasanze Cell received and resolved citizens' complaints as follows: 2017-2018: received 23,456, resolved 15,541; 2018-2019: received 14,578, resolved 13,312; 2019-2020: received 8,000, resolved 7,790; 2020-2021: received 4,325, resolved 4,225. What is the general percentage of unresolved complaints compared with the grand total of all complaints received?
How many are the affiliated agencies to the Ministry of Local Government?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: MINALOC lists five affiliated institutions: NEC, NRS, LODA, NCPD and RDRC.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: How many national symbols does Rwanda have?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Article 9(1) of the Constitution lists four national symbols: the National Flag, the Motto of the Republic, the Seal of the Republic and the National Anthem. None of 2, 5 or 3 is right.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: According to the fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census, what was the adult literacy rate in Rwanda in 2022?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: RPHC5 found that 79% of the resident population aged 15 and above can read and write with understanding in any language. 89.3% is the primary net attendance rate.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Bailiffs shall be in ..... categories.
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Article 3 of Law 12/2013 provides two categories: professional and non-professional bailiffs.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The following administrative structure is established at Cell level:
options: A representative of teachers of primary schools in the Cell
The Coordinator of the National Women's Council at the Cell level
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The management organs of the Cell are the Cell Council, the Executive Secretariat and the Consultative Committee on Development of the Cell. The teachers' representative and the Women's Council coordinator are only members of the Cell Council.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Who are the members of the community works Technical Committee at village level?
options: The Executive Committee of the Village and two persons of integrity chosen by the population, respecting equality between men and women
Members of the Cell Advisory Committee only
The Executive Committee of the Village only
Two persons of integrity chosen by the population only
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The village Technical Committee is made of the Village Executive Committee plus two persons of integrity chosen by the population, respecting gender equality.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Umuganda is held on:
options: The first Saturday of the month
The last Saturday of the month
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Umuganda, the national community work day, takes place on the last Saturday of every month.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Which one of the following is one of the characteristics of a patriotic Rwandan citizen?
options: Participation of citizens in national development
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The NURC/Itorero study on Rwandan cultural values lists devotion among the characteristics of a patriotic Rwandan citizen. Participation in national development and transparency are values of good service delivery, and fighting against injustice is a value promoting justice.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: What are the pillars of NST1?
options: Economic transformation, social transformation, transformational governance
Economic transformation, social transformation, transformational leadership, transformational governance and cross-cutting
Economic transformation, project management, social transformation, transformational leadership, transformational governance and cross-cutting
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: NST1 rests on three pillars: Economic Transformation, Social Transformation and Transformational Governance. Cross-cutting areas are treated separately and are not pillars.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: According to NST1, online service delivery will be at which percentage in 2024?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: NST1 sets the target that 100% of Government services are delivered online by 2024 (from 40%).

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: What is the vision of the revised National Decentralisation Policy of 2021?
options: A self-reliant, secure, politically mature and informed society for sustainable national transformation
To build a highly effective and accountable Local Government driven by citizen-centred governance for local socio-economic transformation
A fully mobilised, empowered, engaged and proud citizen for sustainable socio-economic transformation
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The 2021 National Decentralisation Policy states its Vision as "A self-reliant, secure, politically mature and informed society for sustainable national transformation"; option B is its Mission.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Which law governs the fight against corruption in Rwanda?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The law on fighting against corruption is Law N° 54/2018 of 13/08/2018.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Our national flag has three colours: blue, yellow and green. What does the light blue represent?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Blue stands for happiness and peace; yellow for economic development; green for hope of prosperity.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The deepest lake in East Africa is ...
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Lake Tanganyika (about 1,470 m deep) is the deepest lake in Africa; Lake Victoria is very shallow (under 100 m).

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: According to NST1, the target for citizens satisfied by service delivery by 2024 is:
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: NST1 says the percentage of citizens satisfied with service delivery will rise from 67.7% (2016 RGS) to 90% by 2024.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Define "freehold":
options: Contract where the State grants the right to use private State land for investment and social welfare for a fixed term
A form of land tenure based on a contract between a person and the State granting full and indefinite rights over the land
Type of land ownership based on a long-term contract between the State and a person
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Law 27/2021 defines freehold as a form of land tenure based on a contract between a person and the State granting full and indefinite rights over the land (option A is the definition of land concession).

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: One of the following is NOT a responsibility of the Consultative Committee on Development of the Cell. Which one is it?
options: To provide civil status services specified by the law which are not delivered at the Sector level
To identify fundamental activities to be considered in poverty eradication programmes and service provision
To assess the implementation of the programmes approved by the competent organs and those approved by the Cell Council
To advise on equitable distribution of development activities in the Cell
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Providing civil status services is a duty of the Cell Executive Secretary; the Consultative Committee on Development only advises, monitors, assesses and settles disputes among development organs.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: In which circumstances can the normal five-year term of the Abunzi be continued?
options: The Minister of Justice has the right to extend the mandate of the Abunzi Committee
If the Committee demonstrates professionalism in the exercise of its duties
If the population requests the extension in writing to the Mayor of the District
If the term of office expires and there is an event of force majeure which makes it impossible to conduct elections
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Law 020/2020 amended the Abunzi law so that, if a term expires and force majeure makes elections impossible, outgoing members keep working until their replacements are elected.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Most villages do not have administrative offices. According to Presidential Order No 001/01 of 06/02/2023 relating to the Sector, Cell and Village, where are Village Council meetings held?
options: They rent an office for the occasion
The District makes funds available to rent meeting rooms
In any place in the Village constituency determined by the Bureau of the Village Council
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The Order says the Village Council meeting is held in the Village constituency, in a place determined by the Bureau of the Village Council.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: In which year was the new labour law published in the Official Gazette?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The labour law, Law 66/2018 of 30/08/2018 regulating labour in Rwanda, was published in the Official Gazette Special of 06/09/2018. It was later amended by Law 027/2023 of 18/05/2023 (OG Special of 30/05/2023). Neither 2018 nor 2023 is among 2019, 2020 or 2017, so "None of the mentioned" holds under either reading of "new labour law".

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: There is a list of guiding principles of a public servant. How many are there?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Presidential Order 021/01 of 24/02/2021 on professional ethics for public servants, Chapter II Section One, Arts 4-9 give six guiding principles: excellence and professionalism, accountability, integrity and trustworthiness, person-centeredness of service delivery, impartiality, transparency and collaboration.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: How many Ministers are members of the Advisory Council for the Fight against Injustice and Corruption at national level?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Presidential Order n 072/01 of 31/10/2023, Art. 2: the national Advisory Council includes two Ministers, the Minister in charge of justice (Chairperson) and the Minister in charge of local government (Vice-Chairperson).

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: How many people sign the death record?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Article 95(2) of Law 71/2024: the death record is signed by the declarant, two witnesses aged 18 or over and the civil registrar, which is four people. The "None" option is replaced by the real value (4) so the item survives shuffling.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Gasanze cell complaints: 2017-18 received 23,456, resolved 15,541; 2018-19 received 14,578, resolved 13,312; 2019-20 received 8,000, resolved 7,790; 2020-21 received 4,325, resolved 4,225. What is the total received and resolved over all fiscal years?
Who is the Minister in charge of Emergency Management?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Albert Murasira is the Minister in charge of Emergency Management (MINEMA).

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The current Constitution of Rwanda was adopted in:
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The current Constitution is the Constitution of 2003 (revised in 2015).

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Compared with the annual action plan, Imihigo should consist of:
options: Activities extracted from the annual action plan that are important, target significant changes and have results evaluable by clear indicators
All routine activities of the annual action plan without exception
Activities without any indicators, so that results cannot be evaluated
Only activities financed by development partners
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Imihigo are key, high-impact activities selected from the annual action plan and measured through output indicators, so all three statements hold.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Define "expropriation"
options: taking of private land by the State in the public interest with fair compensation
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Expropriation in the public interest is the removal of a person from property by Government after fair compensation.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Human security focuses on:
options: freedom from fear, freedom from want and dignity
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: UN General Assembly Resolution 66/290 defines human security around freedom from fear, freedom from want and the right to live in dignity, not only state borders.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The Cell Executive Secretary is responsible for:
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The Cell Executive Secretary performs the daily duties of Cell administration.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Complete the missing: The Village Executive Committee meets ............... days and at any time necessary. It is convened and chaired by the Village Coordinator.
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Under the current Presidential Order on the Sector, Cell and Village, the Village Executive Committee meets twice a month and whenever necessary, which is once in fifteen days.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The meeting of the Bureau of the Cell Council is held as follows:
options: once a quarter and whenever necessary
once a month and whenever necessary
once every two months and whenever necessary
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The Bureau of the Cell Council (Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson and Secretary) meets once a month and whenever necessary. The full Cell Council meets once every two months.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The formulation of plans at all levels in Central and Local Government will follow ......
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The RBM Policy states that formulation of plans at all levels in Central and Local Government will follow a participatory process.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: A public servant who is absent from work for one (1) day without a valid justification is sanctioned by:
options: a suspension without pay for a maximum period of three (3) months
a suspension of at least 2 months
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Under the professional ethics order, one day of unjustified absence is a reprimand (a warning is for lateness, late reports or minor equipment loss).

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: What does RALGA mean in full words?
options: Rwanda Association of Local Government Authorities
Rwanda Authority for Local Governance Administration
Rwanda Administration for Local Government Authority
Rwanda Agency for Local Governance Authority
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: RALGA stands for the Rwanda Association of Local Government Authorities, the association of local governments that, with its Local Governance Institute, supports local government capacity.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The home grown solution that enables citizens to keep their leaders accountable and accelerate socio-economic development is:
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Imihigo are the performance contracts through which local leaders commit to targets and are held to account, introduced to speed up development and strengthen accountability.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The land committee at Cell level provides information that needs validation by the land committee at Sector level, relating to the following:
options: holders of land rights during the first land registration
land that has undergone unregistered changes
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The Cell committee itself provides information on holders of land rights at first registration, unregistered land and land with unregistered changes without Sector validation. Information on escheat and vacant land, unregistered State land, State land registered on individuals and similar matters needs validation by the Sector committee.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Which one of the following is not a commendable achievement of the implementation of the decentralization policy?
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The policy describes commendable achievements in political, administrative, financial and fiscal decentralization and in local economic development. Social decentralization is not listed.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: The Consultative Committee on Development of the Cell has the following responsibilities:
options: to encourage the population to contribute to and participate in sustainable development activities
to monitor the performance of the umuganda supervising committee at the Cell level

to provide the population with reliable information about Government programmes, to encourage the population to implement the programmes and collect data about such programmes and submit them to the Cell
to advise on equitable distribution of development activities in the Cell
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: The Consultative Committee advises the Cell on economic matters, assesses programme implementation, monitors services, identifies poverty-reduction priorities, monitors poverty programmes, advises on equitable distribution of development activities and settles disputes among development organs. The ticked option is a Village responsibility.

executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Which one of the following is not a member of the Sector Council?
options: A representative of the private sector in the Sector
A leader representing hospitals, health centres or other health facilities operating in the Sector
A representative of Non-Governmental Organisations operating in the Sector
The Coordinator of the National Youth Council at the Cell level
executive-secretary-full-mock-5.explanation: Under the 2023 order the Sector Council includes the Bureau members of the National Youth Council at Sector level, an NGO representative, a private sector representative and a health official; it has no Cell youth coordinator and no co-operatives representative, so the original item has two non-members.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: As per the fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census, what is the percentage of Rwanda's households that practise agriculture?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: RPHC5 counts 2.3 million agricultural households, which is 69% of private households (83% of rural and 34% of urban private households).

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: The mission of the revised National Employment Policy is:
options: To strengthen and promote creation of productive jobs for all and a conducive environment for employment
To enhance employable skills and competence for all
To strengthen a well-functioning labour market information system
A country with full, sustainable and productive employment: productive work for all.
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The revised National Employment Policy states its mission as strengthening and promoting the creation of productive jobs for all and a conducive environment for employment. The last option is its vision, and the others are specific objectives.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: In the City of Kigali zoning system, the codes A1, C3, R1B and PF5 stand for:
options: Public Administration zone; Mixed use zone; High density residential zone; Religious facilities
Agriculture zone; City commercial zone; Rural residential zone; Cemetery
Agriculture zone; Mixed use zone; Low density residential zone; Education and research facilities
Public Administration zone; City commercial zone; Medium density residential improvement zone; Health facilities
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The Kigali Master Plan 2050 zoning table lists A1 as Agriculture zone, C3 as City commercial zone, R1B as Rural residential zone and PF5 as Cemetery/crematoria.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: What are the main objectives of the Girinka programme?
options: Girinka Munyarwanda (One Cow per Poor Family) main objectives are: fighting malnutrition, reducing poverty through dairy farming, improving agricultural productivity through the use of manure, and improving soil quality and reducing erosion through planting trees and grass
Girinka Munyarwanda main objectives are to increase the production of meat on the market so that the price is affordable for all citizens
Girinka Munyarwanda main objectives are to help veterinary pharmacy owners access the market for their products
Girinka Munyarwanda main objectives are to have manure, especially among farmers, so that the harvest is assured
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Girinka aims to reduce poverty through dairy farming, improve livelihoods and nutrition through milk, raise productivity through manure, and improve soil quality and reduce erosion by planting grasses and trees.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: The Umurenge SACCO aims to:
options: Help citizens save and access credit close to home
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Umurenge SACCOs were created (one per sector) to bring savings and credit services close to rural Rwandans.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: The "Made in Rwanda" policy aims to:
options: Promote locally produced goods and their markets
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The Made in Rwanda policy (Cabinet 2017) promotes local production, quality and domestic and export markets to cut imports of goods that can be made locally.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: According to the fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census (2022), the least populated District in Rwanda is:
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: RPHC5 (2022) Table 1: the smallest district is Nyaruguru (318,126 in the table; the text says 318,900), just below Nyabihu (319,047). Kayonza (457,156), Rulindo (360,144) and Gisagara (397,051) are all larger, so "None is correct" is right. (Kayonza is the least DENSELY populated district.)

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: What is the current poverty rate in Rwanda according to the 2023/24 Integrated Household Living Conditions Survey (EICV7)?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: EICV7 (2023/24) puts the national poverty rate at 27.4%.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Which one of the following is a pillar of Vision 2050?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Vision 2050's pillars are Human Development, Competitiveness and Integration, Agriculture for Wealth Creation, Urbanization and Agglomeration, and Accountable and Capable State Institutions. Solidarity and Dignity (Agaciro) is a shared value, and Economic Transformation is an NST1 pillar.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Which one of the following is NOT a criterion used by RGB to qualify an innovation as a Home Grown Solution?
options: An innovation that has proved to be a solution to a particular problem
An innovation that addresses a challenge in a new and different way, often through simpler and more effective approaches
An innovation or initiative rooted in the Rwandan cultural heritage and values
A practice imported from another country and applied unchanged, without adaptation to Rwanda
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: RGB lists five criteria for a Home Grown Solution, including all four options shown (the post-genocide political philosophy criterion is one of them), so the item has no correct option as written.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: The Imihigo program is based on main objectives. How many are there?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The Government of Rwanda presentation on Imihigo lists seven objectives: speed up implementation, stakeholder ownership, accountability and transparency, results orientation, innovation and competitiveness, zeal and determination, and a culture of results.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: EICV stands for:
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: EICV is the NISR Integrated Household Living Conditions Survey (French: Enquete Integrale sur les Conditions de Vie des menages).

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: The Cabinet of Rwanda consists of:
options: the Ministers and Ministers of State
the Prime Minister, Ministers, Ministers of State and other members nominated by the President
the Prime Minister, Ministers, Ministers of State
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The Constitution says the Cabinet comprises the Prime Minister, Ministers, Ministers of State and other members determined by the President.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Which of the following is one of the five pillars of Vision 2050?
options: Human Resource Development and a Knowledge-based Economy
Good Governance and a Capable State
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The five pillars of Vision 2050 are Human Development, Competitiveness and Integration, Agriculture for Wealth Creation, Urbanization and Agglomeration, and Accountable and Capable State Institutions. 'Good Governance and a Capable State' and the other two options are Vision 2020 pillar wordings.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Which of the following is NOT a pillar of NST1 (2017-2024)?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: NST1 (2017-2024) had three pillars: Economic Transformation, Social Transformation and Transformational Governance. "Socio-economic transformation" is not a pillar, so as written (A, B and C are all pillars) the item has no single correct option.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Under the 2013 EAC Monetary Union Protocol roadmap, the East African Community was originally due to have a single currency by ...
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The 2013 EAC Monetary Union Protocol set 2024 for the single currency, but in August 2024 the EAC Secretary General revised the timeline to 2031, so no listed year is the current expectation.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: The Economic and Human Capital Development Officer has the duty to collect and consolidate data on specific social, health and education programs and prepare the reports. What are the main parts of any formal written report?
options: Title or Cover page - Table of contents - Introduction - Body - Recommendations
Title or Cover page - Introduction - Executive summary - Body - Recommendations - Conclusion
Title or Cover page - Table of contents - Executive summary - Introduction - Body - Conclusion - Recommendations
Title or Cover page - Executive summary - Main content - Conclusion - Recommendations
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: A formal report has a title page, table of contents, executive summary, introduction, body, conclusion and recommendations, with the executive summary before the introduction.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: What is a practical benefit of a SEDO coordinating with both agricultural extension staff and local cooperatives?
options: It helps align technical agricultural advice with the cooperatives’ actual production and marketing activities
There is no practical benefit since the two functions are unrelated
It is required only once a year
It replaces the need for farmer training entirely
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Coordinating extension advice with cooperative activity helps ensure technical guidance (e.g. on planting or inputs) is relevant to what cooperatives are actually producing and marketing, improving outcomes.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: What is NEP in Rwanda?
options: The National Employment Policy is a document for promoting employment and income generating opportunities for Rwandans.

The National Employment Policy is a guiding document for the implementation of other policies in which some of the interventions have interfaces in promoting employment and opportunities for Rwandans.
The National Employment Policy is a guidelines document for the implementation of employment policy and youth generating income opportunities for rural area.

The National Employment Policy is a guiding document for the implementation of other policies in which some of the interventions have interfaces in promoting employment and income generating opportunities for Rwandans.
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The Revised National Employment Policy (2019) describes itself word for word as a guiding document for the implementation of other policies whose interventions have interfaces in promoting employment and income generating opportunities for Rwandans.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: How many national symbols does Rwanda have?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Article 9(1) of the Constitution lists four national symbols: the National Flag, the Motto of the Republic, the Seal of the Republic and the National Anthem. None of 2, 5 or 3 is right.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: According to the fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census, what was the adult literacy rate in Rwanda in 2022?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: RPHC5 found that 79% of the resident population aged 15 and above can read and write with understanding in any language. 89.3% is the primary net attendance rate.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: According to the VUP Programme Document (LODA, 2022), which of these is a responsibility of the Cell (Akagari) in VUP implementation?
options: Monitoring VUP payment distribution to prevent diversion of funds
Preparing payrolls and payment orders for VUP safety-net payments
Adjudicating appeals on VUP safety-net schemes and escalating them
Procuring materials and equipment for VUP public works projects
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The programme document gives the Cell the duty to monitor VUP payment distribution and prevent diversion of public funds. Payrolls and procurement belong to the District, and appeals are handled by the Sector.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Which one of the following is one of the characteristics of a patriotic Rwandan citizen?
options: Participation of citizens in national development
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The NURC/Itorero study on Rwandan cultural values lists devotion among the characteristics of a patriotic Rwandan citizen. Participation in national development and transparency are values of good service delivery, and fighting against injustice is a value promoting justice.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: In the Rwanda Labour Force Survey (RLFS) run by NISR, results such as the unemployment rate are reported for persons of what age?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The RLFS collects data on people aged 14 and above, but only persons aged 16 and above are covered for reporting (the working-age population).

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: What are the pillars of NST1?
options: Economic transformation, social transformation, transformational governance
Economic transformation, social transformation, transformational leadership, transformational governance and cross-cutting
Economic transformation, project management, social transformation, transformational leadership, transformational governance and cross-cutting
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: NST1 rests on three pillars: Economic Transformation, Social Transformation and Transformational Governance. Cross-cutting areas are treated separately and are not pillars.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: According to NST1, online service delivery will be at which percentage in 2024?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: NST1 sets the target that 100% of Government services are delivered online by 2024 (from 40%).

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: What is the vision of the revised National Decentralisation Policy of 2021?
options: A self-reliant, secure, politically mature and informed society for sustainable national transformation
To build a highly effective and accountable Local Government driven by citizen-centred governance for local socio-economic transformation
A fully mobilised, empowered, engaged and proud citizen for sustainable socio-economic transformation
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The 2021 National Decentralisation Policy states its Vision as "A self-reliant, secure, politically mature and informed society for sustainable national transformation"; option B is its Mission.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Our national flag has three colours: blue, yellow and green. What does the light blue represent?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Blue stands for happiness and peace; yellow for economic development; green for hope of prosperity.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: The deepest lake in East Africa is ...
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Lake Tanganyika (about 1,470 m deep) is the deepest lake in Africa; Lake Victoria is very shallow (under 100 m).

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: According to NST1, the target for citizens satisfied by service delivery by 2024 is:
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: NST1 says the percentage of citizens satisfied with service delivery will rise from 67.7% (2016 RGS) to 90% by 2024.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Who is the Minister in charge of Emergency Management?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Albert Murasira is the Minister in charge of Emergency Management (MINEMA).

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: According to the VUP Programme Document (LODA, 2022), which administrative level leads the identification of VUP public works projects?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The programme document gives the Village the role to lead the identification of public works projects, through community meetings. The Cell collects and validates village data and monitors payments.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: The home grown solution that enables citizens to keep their leaders accountable and accelerate socio-economic development is:
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Imihigo are the performance contracts through which local leaders commit to targets and are held to account, introduced to speed up development and strengthen accountability.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: According to the NISR Labour Force Survey annual report for 2025, what was Rwanda's unemployment rate in 2025?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The 2025 annual RLFS put unemployment at 12.4%, down 2.5 points from 14.9% in 2024. 13.4% was a single-quarter figure (Q2 2025).

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Which one of the following is not a commendable achievement of the implementation of the decentralization policy?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The policy describes commendable achievements in political, administrative, financial and fiscal decentralization and in local economic development. Social decentralization is not listed.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Why is there a direct link between local planning and national planning in Rwanda?
options: National plans take local priorities into account, local plans and Imihigo align with national priorities, and national programmes are implemented through local government
Local governments prepare their plans independently and national government does not use them
National planning is done only by MINECOFIN and Districts only spend the budget they receive
Local Imihigo are prepared without reference to the National Strategy for Transformation
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: National plans take local priorities into account, local plans and Imihigo align with the NST and national priorities, and Districts implement national programmes.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Rwanda has developed the necessary policies and tools for attaining Vision 2020 as well as Vision 2050. By this, the term vision means:
options: A short term aspiration of what a country wants to achieve in specific period of time
A long term aspiration of what a country wants to achieve in specific period of time
A medium period plan that includes what a country wants to achieve
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Vision 2020 and Vision 2050 are Rwanda's long-term national frameworks (Vision 2050 sets the framework for 2020-2050), so a vision is a long-term aspiration of what a country wants to achieve in a specific period.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Under Law N° 065/2021 governing the District, how often does the District Coordinating Committee, which includes Cell Executive Secretaries, meet in ordinary session?
options: Once every year and whenever necessary
Twice a year and whenever necessary
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The District Coordinating Committee meets once every year and whenever necessary. It is convened and chaired by the District Mayor, with the District Executive Secretary as rapporteur.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: The quality of being able to deal with people, having human-relation skills and being friendly is called:
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Sociability is the quality of being sociable, i.e. friendly and good at relating to other people; integrity is honesty/moral soundness, self-confidence is trust in oneself.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Imihigo performance contracts were introduced in Rwanda in:
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The first Imihigo were signed in 2006 between the President and district mayors, at the start of the second phase of decentralisation.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Which development strategy preceded NST1?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: NST1 (2017-2024) followed the Economic Development and Poverty Reduction Strategy II (EDPRS 2, 2013-2018) as Rwanda's medium-term plan; Agaciro, Ubudehe and Imihigo are home-grown solutions, not national development strategies.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: The role of the Cell SEDO is to:
options: Plan, monitor and report on economic development activities in the Cell
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The Cell Socio-Economic Development Officer coordinates planning, monitoring and reporting of socio-economic activities in the Cell under the Cell Executive Secretary.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: When did the United Nations Millennium Development Goals (MDGs) start?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The Millennium Declaration containing the MDGs came from the UN Millennium Summit of 6-8 September 2000, so November, June and December 2000 are all wrong.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Each State organ must monitor the implementation of individual performance contracts for its staff on the basis of indicators determined by ...
options: The head of the state organ
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Art 16 of Law 18/2017: each State organ monitors individual staff performance contracts on the basis of indicators determined by the Ministry in charge of public service (MIFOTRA), by a Ministerial Order. None of the options names it (the head of the organ, MINALOC, MINECOFIN).

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) are:
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: The 2030 Agenda has 17 Sustainable Development Goals.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: According to the 5th Rwanda Population and Housing Census (RPHC5), youth (16-30 years) constitute ... of the Rwandan population.
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Youth aged 16-30 are 27.1% (3.6 million) of the population.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: What does NST2 stand for?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: NST2 is the National Strategy for Transformation 2 (2024-2029), the successor to NST1.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Imihigo are:
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Imihigo are performance contracts that leaders and institutions sign and are evaluated on.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Which NISR operation counted 269,326 business establishments in Rwanda in 2023?
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: NISR's Establishment Census 2023 counted 269,326 establishments, 15.9% more than in 2020. FinScope measures access to financial services, and the Labour Force Survey measures employment.

sedo-full-mock-1.stem: Rwanda's official languages are:
sedo-full-mock-1.explanation: Under Article 8 of the Constitution, Kinyarwanda is the national language and Kinyarwanda, French and English are official languages (Kiswahili was added in 2017).

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Between 2012 and 2022, the fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census (RPHC5) indicated an inter-censal annual growth rate of:
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: RPHC5 shows an inter-censal annual population growth rate of 2.3% between 2012 and 2022.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: According to the fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census (RPHC5), females represent what share of the Rwandan population?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: RPHC5 counted 6,817,068 females, i.e. 51.5% of the resident population.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Which of the following City of Kigali master plan implementation tools specifically targets the low-income population?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The Kigali Master Plan Implementation Plan describes Site & Services as an implementing tool intended to target the low-income population, with some subsidy mechanisms.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: The main objective of the Girinka programme is:
options: To reduce poverty and malnutrition by giving a cow to a poor family
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Girinka (One Cow per Poor Family), launched in 2006, aims to reduce poverty and malnutrition among poor rural households through livestock asset transfer.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: The Agaciro Development Fund was established in:
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The Agaciro Development Fund was launched by President Kagame on 23 August 2012 after the December 2011 Umushyikirano proposal.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: As per the fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census (RPHC5), what is the rate of Rwandan households with access to potable (improved) drinking water?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: RPHC5 reports that 82% (82.3%) of private households drink water from improved sources; 96% is the urban figure.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: According to the 5th Rwanda Population and Housing Census (RPHC5), what percentage of households practise agriculture?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: About 2.3 million households, 69% of private households, practise agricultural activities (63% do crop farming).

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Horticulture encompasses:
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Rwanda's horticulture sector covers fruits, vegetables and flowers; coffee and tea are traditional export crops.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: RPHC stands for:
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: RPHC is the abbreviation NISR uses for the Rwanda Population and Housing Census (the fifth, RPHC5, was held in August 2022).

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: The NST1 has considered ... cross-cutting areas to attain inclusive and sustainable development.
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: NST1 lists seven cross-cutting areas: capacity development, HIV/AIDS and NCDs, disability and social inclusion, gender and family promotion, regional integration, disaster management, environment and climate change.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: The law governing results-based performance management in branches of Government is:
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The law is Law No 18/2017 of 28/04/2017 governing Results-Based Performance Management in branches of Government.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: In the implementation of decentralization policy since its adoption in 2001, the following major challenge hindered the effective decentralization processes:
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The policy's list of major challenges includes sectoral decentralization that is yet to foster strategic linkages. Constant development partner commitment and continuous leadership commitment are lessons learnt (strengths), and capacity development is a pillar, whereas the challenge is capacity constraints.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: To be classified as a National Hero in Rwanda, a person shall meet ..... criteria:
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: CHENO lists nine characteristics a person must meet to be classified as a National Hero: integrity, patriotism, sacrifice, vision, bravery, being an example, truthfulness, magnanimity and humanity.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Farmers report sick livestock with symptoms spreading between animals. What should you do?
options: Advise farmers to sell the animals immediately with no reporting
Report it promptly to veterinary/agricultural authorities so the outbreak can be assessed and contained
Ignore it since livestock health is not your role at all
Tell farmers to treat it themselves with no guidance
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: A possible disease outbreak should be reported promptly to the relevant veterinary or agricultural authority, to protect livestock and livelihoods across the area.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Several informal traders operate in your sector without registration. What is a constructive approach?
options: Shut them down immediately with no support
Encourage and support them to formalise, explaining the benefits and guiding them through registration
Demand informal payments to let them continue
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Encouraging and supporting formalisation, rather than simply shutting traders down or ignoring the issue, helps bring them into the formal economy with its protections and opportunities.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: A newly formed cooperative has no experience keeping financial records. What is helpful guidance to offer?
options: Tell them bookkeeping is unnecessary for small cooperatives
Advise basic practices: recording all income and expenses, keeping receipts, and reviewing records regularly
Offer to keep their records secretly on their behalf, permanently
Tell them to wait until they are audited to start recording anything
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Basic bookkeeping practices — recording transactions, keeping receipts, and reviewing records regularly — build the habits a cooperative needs for transparency and accountability to its own members.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Accounts of long-term savings scheme are established for the persons of .... categories.
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Article 6 of Law 29/2017 lists six categories of persons for whom Ejo Heza accounts are established.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Why do we call agriculture the backbone of Rwanda's economy?
options: Because it is the largest source of employment and makes a major contribution to GDP and to export earnings
Because 90% of Rwandans work in the agriculture sector
Because it uses mainly modern technologies
Because it has a great variety of crops
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The 33% GDP / 72% employment figures are old (about 2016) values; current official data show a lower GDP share and employment share, though agriculture is still the largest employer.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: The State of Rwanda, through its Constitution, commits itself to upholding the fundamental principles and ensuring their respect. How many are they?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Article 10 of the Constitution as amended in 2015 lists six fundamental principles (earlier version had eight).

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: When was the ICTR established?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The UN Security Council established the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda by resolution 955 on 8 November 1994.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Which one of the following is not a guiding principle of decentralization?
options: National unity, indivisibility and equitable development
Establish Community data center at cell level
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The guiding principles include subsidiarity, national unity, indivisibility and equitable development, and demarcation of roles and responsibilities. Establishing a community data centre at Cell level is a policy action under data and information systems, not a principle.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: What is the area of Rwanda?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: NISR gives Rwanda's surface area as 26,338 square kilometres (24,210 km2 land plus 2,120 km2 water and swamps).

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: What are the pillars of the National Strategy for Transformation (NST1) 2017-2024?
options: Good governance and capable State; Human resource development and a knowledge-based economy; Private sector-led development; Infrastructure development; Productive, high-value and market-oriented agriculture; Regional and international integration
Human development; Agriculture for wealth creation; Competitiveness and integration; Urbanisation and agglomeration; Accountable and capable State institutions
Economic Transformation; Social Transformation; Transformational Governance
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: NST1 (2017-2024) is built on three pillars: Economic Transformation, Social Transformation and Transformational Governance.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: What are the three forms of decentralisation?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Rwanda's decentralisation policy names three forms: deconcentration, devolution and delegation.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: A cooperative wants to adopt Crop Intensification Programme practices but lacks access to improved seed. What is the most appropriate SEDO response?
options: Connect the cooperative with the relevant agricultural extension or input-supply channel
Tell the cooperative CIP support does not exist
Supply the seed personally from the SEDO’s own funds
Advise the cooperative to abandon the idea entirely
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The appropriate role is to connect the cooperative to the correct channel for CIP-related support (such as extension services or approved input suppliers), not to personally fund or supply inputs.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Which organ has the responsibility to coordinate and follow up the Joint Action Development Forum activities?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The Rwanda Governance Board is the institution in charge of coordinating JADF activities at national level.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: There are ...... categories of heroes celebrated on Rwanda Heroes' Day.
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Rwandan national heroes are in three categories: Imanzi, Imena and Ingenzi.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: How many countries belong to the African Union?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The African Union has 55 Member States, covering all the countries on the African continent.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: On 1st July every year, Rwanda celebrates:
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: 1 July is Independence Day; Liberation Day is 4 July.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Fill in the missing: The aspirations of the government of Rwanda to become ....................
options: the Upper Middle Income country by 2035 and High Income country by 2050
the Upper Middle Income country by 2035 and High Income country by 2060
the Upper Middle Income country by 2045 and High Income country by 2065
the Upper Middle Income country by 2025 and High Income country by 2060
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Vision 2050 aims for Rwanda to be an upper-middle income country by 2035 and a high-income country by 2050.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: The sectoral decentralization and service delivery have different issues. Which one is it?
options: The capacity gap in the matter related to Public Financial Management is still critical at decentralized entities
Limited availability and use of data and information management systems at Local Government level
Decentralized tax revenue sources are limited
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Limited availability and use of data and information management systems at Local Government level is a policy issue listed under Pillar 1, sectoral decentralization and service delivery. The public financial management and tax revenue issues belong to Pillar 2, fiscal and financial decentralization, and capacity development is Pillar 3.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Which form of decentralisation matches this definition: the transfer of functions and resources to lower-level units of the same administrative system while authority over decision-making and use of such resources remains with the centre?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: This is the policy definition of deconcentration: functions move to lower units but power and authority stay with the centre.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: According to the VUP Programme Document (LODA, 2022), which of the following is NOT a Cell-level responsibility in VUP?
options: Collecting and synthesising data from Villages
Supervising Proximity Advisory Services in the Cell
Preparing payrolls for VUP safety-net payments
Raising awareness of beneficiaries' rights and duties
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Payrolls and payment orders for safety-net payments are prepared by the District. The Cell collects village data, supervises Proximity Advisory Services and raises community awareness.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: How many Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) are there?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The 2030 Agenda has 17 Sustainable Development Goals.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Rwanda recognises the importance of culture and values in providing a platform for sustained socio-economic transformation and prosperity. Which of the following sets of values is reflected among the values of Rwanda in Vision 2050?
options: Justice, Kindness, Knowledge, Leadership, Loyalty, Work, Openness, Optimism, Peace
Self-determination, Solidarity and Dignity, Unity and Reconciliation, Identity
Respect, Responsibility, Security, Self-Respect, Service, Stability, Success
Authenticity, Achievement, Authority, Autonomy, Balance of gender, Compassion, Citizenship, Community
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Vision 2050 (Positive Values supporting Societal Transformation) names self-determination (Kwigira), solidarity and dignity (Agaciro), unity and Rwandan identity/culture, with unity and reconciliation as a key value, plus equity and inclusiveness.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: According to the 2025 annual Labour Force Survey, which broad sector employed the largest share of employed people?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: In 2025 services employed 44.4% of workers, agriculture 39.1% and industry 16.5%.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Rwanda Vision 2020 was launched in:
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The Rwanda Vision 2020 document was issued by the Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning in Kigali in July 2000.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Which of the following is NOT a Rwandan Home-Grown Solution?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Gacaca, Girinka and Imihigo are home-grown solutions; the East African Community is a regional organisation, not a home-grown solution.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: A "baseline" is:
options: Initial data showing the situation before an intervention begins
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: A baseline is the initial data describing the situation before an intervention begins, used to measure change later.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Under the VUP Programme Document (LODA, 2022), which level adjudicates appeals on VUP safety-net schemes and escalates unresolved grievances to the District?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The Sector adjudicates appeals for VUP safety-net schemes and escalates unresolved grievances to the District. The Cell resolves problems beyond the Village and reports those beyond its mandate.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: What do you understand by "medium term" in planning?
options: A period longer than one (1) year but not exceeding three (3) years
A period longer than one (1) year but not exceeding five (5) years
A period of one (1) year but not exceeding three (3) years
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Art 2(4) of Law 18/2017: medium term is a period longer than one year but not exceeding five years.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Performance contracts of an organ and individual staff performance contracts are evaluated on the basis of ...
options: Criteria fixed by the Prime Minister's Office
Criteria fixed by the Presidential Office
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Art 19(1) of Law 18/2017: organ and individual staff performance contracts are evaluated on the basis of the results achieved in relation to the expected results, not on criteria fixed by one of the named offices. (Art 19(2): organ evaluation follows yearly guidance of the Office of the Prime Minister; that is guidance for organ contracts only, while the stem covers both organ and individual contracts.)

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: When were the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) adopted?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The 2030 Agenda with its Sustainable Development Goals was adopted by world leaders at the UN in September 2015.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: By 2050, Rwanda aspires to become a:
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Vision 2050 targets upper-middle-income status by 2035 and high-income status by 2050.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Which of these is a pillar of NST1?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: NST1 (2017-2024) had three pillars: Economic Transformation, Social Transformation and Transformational Governance.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: SDG 2 aims to achieve:
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Sustainable Development Goal 2 is "Zero Hunger": end hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: Where is the EAC headquarters located?
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The East African Community headquarters is in Arusha, Tanzania.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: By 2050, Rwanda aspires to achieve a GDP per capita of:
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Vision 2050 targets a GDP per capita of over USD 12,476 by 2050 (high-income status). USD 4,036 is the 2035 target for upper-middle-income status.

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: According to a District Development Strategy 2024–2029, how are its priorities implemented year by year?
options: Quarterly budgets set by the Sector Council
Annual action plans linked to annual Imihigo
Cell profiles prepared by village leaders
Reports of the Joint Action Development Forum
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: The DDS is implemented through annual action plans aligned with its logical framework, which are integrated into the annual performance contracts (Imihigo).

sedo-full-mock-2.stem: By definition integrity is:
options: the obligation and authority to take the necessary actions to ensure success.
a disposition to be humble; a lack of false pride
the act of consistency of actions, values, methods, measures, principles, expectations and outcome
The spirit of not putting one's self first but being willing to give one's time and resources for the benefit of others
sedo-full-mock-2.explanation: Integrity is consistency of actions, values and principles, being honest with strong moral principles. The other options define responsibility, humility and selflessness.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: As per the fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census (RPHC5), which Province is the most populous among the following?
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: RPHC5 shows Eastern Province as the most populous (3,563,145 people, 26.9%), ahead of Southern Province.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: What are the main agricultural seasons in Rwanda?
options: There are three main agricultural seasons in Rwanda: Season A (September to February), Season B (March to June) and Season C (July to September)
The main agricultural seasons in Rwanda are winter and spring
The main agricultural seasons in Rwanda are the dry season and the rainy season
The main agricultural seasons in Rwanda are summer and autumn
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: NISR's Seasonal Agricultural Survey defines Season A (September to February), Season B (March to June) and Season C (July to September).

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: Agricultural Season A starts in the month of:
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: Under NISR definitions, Season A runs from September to February, Season B from March to June, Season C from July to September.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: A key principle of cooperatives is:
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: Cooperatives follow the International Cooperative Alliance principles, the first being voluntary and open membership, which Rwandan cooperative law adopts.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: What was the poverty rate in Rwanda according to the Fifth Integrated Household Living Conditions Survey (EICV5, 2016/17)?
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: EICV5 (2016/17) measured the national poverty headcount at 38.2%; 39.1% was EICV4 (2013/14) and 44.9% EICV3 (2010/11).

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: After the 1994 genocide, the government of National Unity was established ..........:
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: The Government of National Unity was sworn in on 19 July 1994, the date Rwanda marks each year as the start of national unity and reconstruction.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: Which one of the following is among the main duties of the socio-economic development officer?
options: To identify socio-economic development needs at the Cell level and accordingly take decision on response measures
To facilitate gathering data related to the employment status within the cell
To prepare and sign documents at Cell level
To elaborate him/her self the programs of community works
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: The Cell Socio-Economic Development Officer advertisement lists: identify needs and advise on response measures (not take decisions), prepare documents for the Executive Secretary to sign (not sign them), elaborate community-works programmes under the Executive Secretary's supervision, and facilitate gathering data on the employment status within the Cell.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: When were the SDGs set up?
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: The 2030 Agenda with the 17 Sustainable Development Goals was adopted by the UN in September 2015.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: A produce cooperative sells its goods raw, at low prices. What is a useful suggestion to raise their income?
options: Suggest value-addition training, such as basic processing or better packaging, to improve prices
Tell them to reduce production instead
Tell them to sell at an even lower price to compete
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: Value-addition training can help a cooperative earn more from the same raw produce, by improving quality, packaging or processing before sale.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: Choose the correct response: by their respective percentage in decreasing order of importance, the main types of livestock reared by private households in Rwanda are:
options: Cows, goats, pigs, chickens and rabbits
Cows, pigs, chickens, goats and sheep
Cows, chickens, pigs, sheep and rabbits
Cows, goats, chickens, rabbits and beehives
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: NISR census data show cows (28%), goats (19%), pigs (15%), chickens (12%) and rabbits (6%) as the main livestock of private households.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: Fill in the blanks: The Government of Rwanda revived the one cow per poor family programme (Girinka) in ......... The national agency in charge of coordinating the Girinka programme is ...........
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: Girinka was initiated by President Kagame in 2006 and is coordinated by the Rwanda Agriculture and Animal Resources Development Board (RAB).

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: The main economic activity of most Rwandans is:
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: Agriculture is the main livelihood: 57.6% of the total workforce (including subsistence farmers) works in agriculture.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: How many agricultural seasons do we have in Rwanda?
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: Rwanda has three agricultural seasons: Season A (September-February), Season B (March-June) and Season C (July-September).

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: The Economic and Human Capital Development Officer monitors implementation of the City master plan. According to the findings of the study by Nyiransabimana et al. (2019) on the City of Kigali master plan, which statement is true?
options: The implementation of the City of Kigali master plan improved significantly recreational areas and employment opportunities
The implementation of the City of Kigali master plan is high in areas planned for infrastructure and commercial areas
The implementation of the City of Kigali master plan is high in areas planned for agricultural area
The implementation of the City of Kigali master plan impacted positively on the availability of affordable housing for low-income residents
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: The study found implementation high for agricultural use (77% accordance), low for commercial and infrastructure areas, no significant improvement in recreational areas or employment, and affordable housing availability did not improve.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: A new cooperative asks the SEDO which products might have strong local market demand before they commit to a business line. What is the most useful response?
options: Help them gather relevant local market information (demand, competition, pricing) to inform their decision
Insist they copy an unrelated sector’s cooperative exactly
Discourage them from starting any new venture
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: A SEDO can add real value by helping a new cooperative access relevant local market information, supporting an informed choice rather than guesswork or blanket discouragement.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: From when has Rwanda been a full member of the Commonwealth?
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: Rwanda joined the Commonwealth in 2009 as its 54th member.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: The overall NST1 M&E Framework is grounded on key guiding principles. How many are they?
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: NST1 lists five guiding principles: comprehensiveness; participation and inclusiveness; leverage of ICT tools and dashboards; consistency and harmonization between sector and district strategies; flexibility.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: Why might a SEDO encourage cooperatives in their sector to diversify their marketing channels rather than rely on a single buyer?
options: Relying on one buyer concentrates risk; diversified channels can improve price stability and income resilience
Diversification is required by law for every cooperative
A single buyer always offers the best price
Marketing channels have no effect on cooperative income
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: Depending on a single buyer exposes a cooperative to that buyer’s pricing power or sudden withdrawal; diversifying channels can improve bargaining position and income stability.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: Which one of the following is not a characteristic of customer service strengths?
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: Standard customer-service skill lists name empathy, communication, patience and problem-solving as strengths, so impatience is the opposite of a strength.

sedo-full-mock-3.stem: When did Rwanda join the EAC?
sedo-full-mock-3.explanation: Rwanda (with Burundi) joined the East African Community in July 2007.
